**Job Description**

**Overview**

The department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences has an outstanding opportunity for a Department Staff Human Resources (HR) Specialist.


**About this Opportunity**

Working as part of a departmental HR staff team, this position will provide professional level service to employees, managers, academic personnel, and other staff in support of advancing the department’s staff personnel program. This position will exercise discretion and independent judgment through reviewing and processing personnel change requests and providing guidance on departmental and university staff policies and procedures. As a key policy advisor and business process expert, this role will significantly influence operational integrity and workforce management of the department’s staff personnel program.


**Responsibilities**

Support Staff Personnel Program (75%)


* Independently assess a wide range of HR operational requests, ensuring each action complies with various levels of policies, labor contracts, and applicable employment laws.
* Support the entire employee life cycle including new appointments, reclassifications, and personnel changes for staff and student employees.
* Execute various staff HR actions (i.e. hires, personnel changes, separations, etc.) within the Workday system, adhering to timelines set by payroll, central campus, SoM, and the department to ensure timely completion of actions.
* Advise employees, managers, academic personnel, and other staff on university and departmental policies and procedures.
* Independently manage and prioritize assigned personnel requests via department’s internal ticketing system.
* Work in unison with department HR team to review, assign, and resolve requests that come into the department’s HR shared in box.

Reporting and Process Improvement (20%)


* Engage in continuous process improvement reviews to identify and implement strategies to increase efficiency and develop resources.
* Identify ticketing tool process improvement areas and work collaboratively with Department IT and PsycSource development team to develop technological tools to provide optimal solutions related to HR processes.
* Independently identify best staff HR operating practices and determine how to efficiently implement them on a department level.
* Develop process guides and tools to document and support key functions and activities.
* Develop, implement, and/or modify department tracking mechanisms to monitor and report on the status of HR and payroll processes.
* Prepare reports on HR or payroll related requests as needed.

Other Duties (5%)


* Cover vacations and absences for other HR staff.
* Perform other duties and ad hoc projects, as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications, as applicable, listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.


**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business, communications, or related field OR four years of related work experience.

**Additional Requirements**

* Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion and independent judgment in resolving complex HR issues.
* Knowledge of federal and state employment laws.
* Demonstrated ability in working with a customer service mindset, while maintaining a positive attitude and providing high quality service.
* Ability to handle confidential information with tact, discretion, and diplomacy, and to maintain strict confidentiality, while working to take appropriate action.
* Professional level competency with general MS Office applications (i.e. Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams) and ability to learn new software applications as necessary.
* Ability to manage a high volume of work, meeting time sensitive deadlines, while ensuring work is accurate and complete.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in higher education or academic health system HR operations.
* Familiarity with Workday HCM or similar HRIS systems.

**Working Conditions**

This is a hybrid eligible position. After successful completion of training, the position may be eligible to work with a schedule that has an expectation of 1 day onsite per week on average, with adjustments as needed to meet the needs of the HR team.


**About the Department**

The position includes a broad range of human resources activities, including recruitment and onboarding, student employment administration, position management, personnel record administration, and regulatory compliance.


The Human Resources Specialist exercises sound judgment, discretion, and attention to detail while supporting a diverse and complex workforce. The position partners with departmental leadership, the School, and University Human Resources to deliver responsive customer service, promote effective HR practices, maintain accurate employment records, and support workforce planning and organizational effectiveness initiatives. Through proactive communication, process improvement, and compliance monitoring, this position contributes to a positive employee experience and helps ensure the department's human resources operations are efficient, equitable, and aligned with the University of Washington's mission and values.

* Serve as the primary resource for student employment transactions, processing appointments, changes, extensions, transfers, separations, and other Workday actions

This position requires an individual who is detail\-oriented, possesses strong organizational skills and is able to maintain confidentiality. Academic HR (80%)

Reporting to the Vice Chair for Finance \& Administration, the Associate Director of Human Resources serves as the senior human resources and workforce strategy leader for the Department of Family Medicine. This position provides strategic direction and oversight for workforce planning, organizational design, human resources governance, employee relations, and faculty and staff workforce operations across the department’s clinical, research, and education missions.

The position also serves as the department’s primary liaison to the School of Medicine’s Integrated Resources Shared Services teams, central UW Human Resources, Academic Human Resources, and other institutional partners.


The Department of Family Medicine is a large and complex academic department with an annual budget of approximately $60 million. Its workforce includes approximately 280 paid faculty, 30 residents, six fellows, 120 staff, and more than 1,400 volunteer faculty working across diverse programs, clinical sites, and academic settings throughout the WWAMI region.


**Key Responsibilities**

* **Human capital strategy and HR governance (20%):** Provide strategic guidance to the Department Chair, Vice Chair for Finance \& Administration, and senior leadership regarding workforce planning, organizational design, staffing models, talent management, compensation, employee relations, and workforce risk.
* **Organizational planning and implementation (15%):** Participate in departmental strategic planning and independently develop workforce strategies, implementation plans, governance recommendations, and organizational structures that align operational resources with departmental priorities.
* **Integrated Resources and institutional partnership (10%):** Serve as the department’s primary liaison to School of Medicine Integrated Resources and central UW Human Resources. Align departmental workforce needs with shared\-services delivery, monitor service effectiveness, and escalate complex or high\-risk matters when necessary.
* **Administrative governance and compliance (10%):** Lead departmental implementation of institutional workforce policies, regulatory changes, and human resources initiatives. Ensure departmental practices comply with federal and state requirements, University policies, Faculty Code provisions, ethics requirements, and collective bargaining agreements.
* **Process improvement and risk mitigation (10%):** Identify operational risks, process inefficiencies, service gaps, and compliance concerns. Develop and implement standardized systems, policies, and corrective strategies that improve service delivery, operational consistency, and audit readiness.

* **Staff workforce and employee relations leadership (10%):** Provide senior\-level guidance on complex staff human resources matters in collaboration with Integrated Resources, Employee Relations, and Labor Relations. description:
**Description**
---------------

  

  

**This position is mainly virtual but requires the flexibility of the incumbent to come into the office in Olympia infrequently or as business needs arise.** **The ideal candidate for the Benefits Administrator (HRC2\) position is a detail\-oriented, Human Resources professional with deep expertise in employee benefits administration and compliance.**  

This position will join our Payroll Team. The candidate will bring a strong foundation in benefits administration, compliance, human resource policies, enabling them to provide expert guidance and counsel to managers, supervisors, and employees. With a commitment to equity, integrity, and confidentiality, they administer health benefit actions and shared leave donations for eligible employees in accordance with the Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) and Washington Administrative Code (WAC).  

This candidate excels in managing benefits transactions and data within systems such as HRMS and Benefits 24/7\. They are proactive, adaptable, and collaborative and should be comfortable in providing training and consultation on HR programs, benefits eligibility, and compliance processes.
**Duties**
----------


As the Benefits Administrator, you will serve as the agency’s designated Subject Matter Expert (SME) for health including medical, dental, life, Long Term Disability (LTD), Health Savings Accounts (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), and Dependent Care Assistance Program (DCAP). **Some of your daily tasks include but not limited to:**  

* Interprets, evaluates, and resolves problems pertaining to the application of the Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), the Washington Administrative Code (WAC), Revised Code of Washington (RCW), Office of Financial Management (OFM), Health Care Authority (HCA), Affordable Care Act (ACA), and agency policy and procedures.
* Respond to and research inquiries from employees, other agency benefits coordinators, HCA, and OFM, regarding benefits, insurance, shared leave, Medicare eligibility, LTD claims, PFML, or FMLA.
* Independently consult with managers, supervisors, and employees on Shared Leave, FMLA, and PFML processes and procedures regarding insurance eligibility and how to complete mandatory ACA Worksheets.
* Present training sessions related to specific HR programs.
* Research, review, prepare, access, and enter data into the Human Resource Management System (HRMS) and Benefits 24/7 insurance system.
* Assist in developing, revision, and implementation of HR policies and procedures.
* Verify and approve documents for dependent eligibility on behalf of the HCA.
* Send documents related to benefits to the Imaging Unit to be filed into the employee’s Payroll file.
 **To request a detailed position description, click****here****.**  


**Qualifications**
------------------


**Qualifying candidates will meet one of the following criteria options:**

 **Option 1:**

* Five (5\) years of professional human resource experience.
 **Option 2:**

* Associate degree with focus on business, human resources, social or organizational behavioral sciences, or related field **AND**
* Three (3\) years of professional human resource experience.
 **Option 3:**

* A Bachelor’s degree with focus on business, human resources, social or organizational behavioral sciences, or related field **AND**
* One (1\) year of professional human resource experience.
 **Required experience includes:**

* **Data Management Skills:** Proficiency in handling HR data systems and records.
* **Reporting Expertise:** Ability to prepare detailed business analyses and reports.
* **Conflict Resolution Skills:** Ability to address workplace grievances and complaints.
* **Policy Knowledge:** Understanding of HR policies and procedures for resolving issues.
* **Onboarding Skills:** Ability to facilitate effective employee integration.
* **Communication Skills:** Proficiency in presenting essential HR information.
 **Preferred/Desired Qualifications:**

* Professional HR experience involving benefits administration, leave management, or HR compliance.
* Demonstrated experience interpreting and applying state and federal laws, including Washington Administrative Code, Revised Code Washington, Affordable Care Act, Family Medical Leave Act, Paid Family Medical Leave, and collective bargaining agreements.
* Experience administering or coordinating employee benefits programs, including medical, dental, life, Long Term Disability, Heath Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account, and Dependent Care Assistance Program.
* Experience processing HR transactions in systems such as HRMS, Benefits 24/7, or similar HRIS platforms.
* Experience researching complex HR issues and providing guidance to employees, managers, and external stakeholders.
 **Required equity competencies:**

* The ability to take action to learn and grow.
* The ability to take action to meet the needs of others.
 **Special Requirements/Conditions of Employment:**

* Must be able to pass an Unemployment Insurance (UI) and Paid Family Medical and Leave (PFML) claim and fraud check.

Additionally, we ask that you NOT include photographs or external links within your documents. Any documents uploaded through this platform will be securely transmitted electronically to support application review.**

**Please submit ONLY your Cover Letter and Resume with your Online Application through the "Add Attachments" field. A resume will not substitute for the "work experience" section of the application or vice versa. Applications with blank fields, or supplemental question responses with comments such as "see attachments" may be considered incomplete.**

Ouragency's mission and valuesdrive every decision that we make, determine how we interact with others, and are at the core of who we are. We value Access, Love, Belonging, Equity, and Stewardship. We understand that a work environment that respects your work/life balance is key; that's why many of our positions are eligible for flexible work schedules and teleworking opportunities. Through support, value, and trust, our employees are empowered to grow and develop into their best self.

Women, racial and ethnic minorities, people with disabilities, people over 40 years of age, people with religious beliefs, veterans or people with military status, and people of all sexual orientations and gender identities are encouraged to apply.

If you are having technical difficulties creating, accessing, or completing your application, please contact careershelp@des.wa.gov or (360\) 664\-1960 or toll free (877\) 664\-1960, Washington Relay 711\.

description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Senior Manager, HR Business Partner** **\- Product \& Technology**

Expedia Group is seeking a strategic Senior Manager, HR Business Partner to support our Product \& Technology division. In this role, you’ll work closely with leaders to advance both business outcomes and our people agenda, fostering a high\-performance culture through innovative HR solutions.  

  



*Please note this role is based in Seattle and follows our hybrid work model, requiring a minimum of three in\-office days per week.*

**What you'll do:**

* **Talent Strategy** : Collaborate with global People team partners and business leaders to ensure the success of client groups through strategic talent initiatives. Key areas include identifying high\-potential talent, driving succession planning, and building future\-focused organizational capabilities.
* **Organizational Effectiveness \& Leadership Coaching** : Implement strategies that enable the organization to navigate and thrive through change. Provide coaching and development support to leaders to strengthen their effectiveness and accelerate growth.
* **Strategic Business Partnership** : Act as a trusted advisor to the business by leveraging data\-driven insights to identify trends, diagnose root causes of challenges, and co\-create effective, sustainable solutions that support business goals.
* Lead organizational structure analysis and design, identifying more effective structures and governance models to align with strategic goals.
* Define and implement organizational principles and health objectives, offering strategic insights to optimize performance.
* Design tools (e.g., surveys) to measure organizational effectiveness and assess issues related to structure, talent, and performance.
* Develop and implement programs to improve employee engagement, management capabilities, and leadership development.
* Leverage a deep understanding of business operations and challenges to propose tailored solutions that support organizational objectives.
* Facilitate collaboration among diverse stakeholders to co\-create practical and impactful solutions.
* Apply systems thinking to enhance organizational efficiency, recommending improvements across policies, processes, and structures.
* Evaluate the long\-term financial and operational impact of proposed solutions to support sustainable business outcomes.
* Serve as a key resource for HR policies and procedures, guiding and educating managers and senior leaders to promote understanding and compliance.
* Partner with HR Centers of Excellence (COEs) and business leaders to design and implement HR programs, ensuring ongoing relevance and effectiveness.
* Provide recommendations on HR structures, tools, and resources to support business needs and enhance organizational capability.
* Apply strong data analysis skills and business acumen to inform decisions related to leadership, structure, and talent development.
* Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory standards in the review and execution of organizational practices.

**Experience and Qualification:**

* 8\+ years’ relevant experience
* Strategic people business partner, experienced in designing end\-to\-end talent agenda, organizational development, delivery of global transformation programs
* Analytical thinking and strategic problem\-solving skills, with the drive to cut. through complexity and turn high\-level business requirements and opportunities into specific initiatives
* Comfortable using advanced executive coaching techniques to make recommendations across opposing and equally critical business needs
* Natural bar\-raiser: curious and passionate about the business context and leadership growth, builds strong relationships by being an inspiring and approachable leader

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $155,000\.00 to $217,000\.00\. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $248,000\.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.  

  

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.  



  

**Benefits and perks**

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life .  



  

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.  



  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .  



  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E\-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I\-9 to confirm work authorization.

description:
**Join Harborstone Credit Union—Where We Build Dreams and Change Lives!**


At Harborstone Credit Union, we're more than a financial institution—we're a team united by a shared purpose: **building dreams and changing lives for generations to come**. Recognized as one of Washington's best workplaces, we foster a culture built on kindness, accountability, growth, and collaboration.


If you're a highly organized, detail\-oriented professional who enjoys supporting others, keeping operations running smoothly, and making a meaningful impact behind the scenes, we'd love to meet you. Join our People and Culture team and help create an exceptional employee experience while supporting the people who serve our members, local businesses, and communities every day.

**This is an in\-person, on\-site position based in our Lakewood administration building.**

**Why Come Work at Harborstone?**

**At Harborstone Credit Union, we invest in our employees and their families by offering a comprehensive and competitive benefits package, including:**

* Competitive pay: **$22\.74 \- $34\.12 hourly**. Dependent on experience\*
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees
* Employer contribution toward dependent medical premiums
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), including employer contributions to dependent care/childcare FSA
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching contributions
* Generous paid vacation and sick leave
* Paid holidays and a personal day
* Professional development and career growth opportunities
* Employee appreciation events and team\-building activities
* Discounted loan rates and other employee financial benefits
* Wellness programs and resources
* A collaborative, supportive culture that values work\-life balance and employee well\-being
* *The posted salary range reflects the full earning potential for the position. Most new hires can expect an offer between the minimum and midpoint of the range, depending on experience, qualifications, and internal equity.*

### **What You'll Do**


As our **HR Coordinator** you will be the first point of contact for Human Resources, providing exceptional customer service while supporting daily HR operations, employee transactions, payroll support, compliance activities, and a variety of administrative processes that keep the department running smoothly.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary contact for the HR phone line, email inbox, and employee inquiries.
* Coordinate HR transactions, onboarding, personnel records, and department communications.
* Assist with payroll administration, compliance tracking, audits, and credential management.
* Support employee lifecycle activities, annual HR processes, and departmental projects.
* Maintain accurate records while delivering timely, confidential, and customer\-focused service.

### **What We're Looking For**


We're looking for a highly organized, detail\-oriented professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and enjoys helping others. The ideal candidate has excellent communication and customer service skills, can successfully manage multiple priorities, maintains strict confidentiality, and is committed to delivering exceptional support to employees and leaders. Experience in Human Resources, payroll, or office administration is preferred.

**Qualifications**

**Education**


Associate's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Bachelor's degree preferred.

**Preferred Certifications**  

 Human Resources certification or coursework preferred.

**Experience**

* Minimum of two (2\) years of administrative experience, preferably in Human Resources, payroll, or office administration.
* Experience providing exceptional customer service in a professional office environment.
* Experience maintaining confidential information and coordinating multiple administrative processes.
* Financial institution experience preferred.
 **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Knowledge of general office practices, administrative procedures, and customer service principles.
* Working knowledge of Human Resources principles and employment practices.
* Ability to maintain confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, frequent interruptions, and changing deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to effectively multitask while maintaining accuracy, attention to detail, and a high level of customer service.
* Ability to prioritize work independently, exercise sound judgment, and follow through on assignments with minimal supervision.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify issues, determine appropriate resources, and ensure timely resolution.
* Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities while maintaining professionalism and confidentiality.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple projects, deadlines, and administrative processes simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong customer service and relationship\-building skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, HRIS, and other business software.
**Physical Considerations**

* Ability to communicate effectively in verbal, written, and electronic formats with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to read, comprehend, and respond to written and verbal instructions and information.
* May be required to sit or stand for extended periods, depending on job duties.
* May involve repetitive motions, including keyboarding and handling office equipment.
* May require stooping, bending, squatting, or reaching occasionally.

Mayor Katie Wilson’s election was powered by thousands of people from every corner of Seattle who came together around a shared vision that it's time for something new — something more hopeful, more just, and more equitable. A vision that we can tackle big challenges and carry out ambitious projects. That we can take on the affordability crisis, bring people inside, and make our city a great place to live, work, and raise a family.


As a coalition builder, she understands that we're in this together. No matter what neighborhood you live in, where you grew up, or how much money you make, you have a right to be here and to live a dignified life. She regularly reminds Seattleites every day that “This is your City.”


To achieve this new kind of participatory and inclusive governance, Mayor Wilson seeks a Director of People Operations who will serve as a leader and a lead communicator to City employees. In this role, you will partner closely with the Seattle Human Resources (SHR) and SHR’s labor relations team on strategies to cultivate a thriving city workforce and ensure strong Mayoral partnership in the City’s labor relations work. You will work together to ensure the Mayor’s Office and Mayor’s Cabinet attracts, retains, and supports a high\-functioning mission\-driven team dedicated to serving the people of Seattle.


You will oversee hiring processes, staffing strategies, personnel actions, labor\-related coordination, and internal training and development efforts for the Mayor’s Office and Cabinet Members, in coordination with SHR. You will work collaboratively with senior leaders to identify staffing needs, manage complex HR workflows, and ensure consistent application of City policies and best practices. You will represent the Mayor’s Office in critical internal labor\-related forums and provide direct leadership to key operational and administrative staff, including managing the Business Operations Manager. You will play a central role in building an effective, equitable, engaged, and well\-supported team culture across the Mayor’s Office and City Leadership.


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Your top 3 priorities in this role will be:*** People Operations within the Mayor’s Office:
	+ Serve as a Senior Advisor for the Mayor, advising on workforce planning, organizational development, personnel issues, and HR strategy.
	+ Act as the main point of contact for hiring processes for the Mayor’s Office and the Cabinet, including recruitment planning, candidate outreach, coordinating searches, onboarding, and ensuring consistent application of City hiring policies and practices.
	+ Coordinate with senior leaders and SHR to design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive training and professional development strategy for Mayor’s Office staff.
	+ Negotiate and manage MOUs, contracts, ethics\-related documents and personnel agreements that support staffing and operational needs within the Mayor’s Office.
	+ Provide leadership, coaching, and support to the Business Operations Manager, who oversees the office\-wide budget, invoicing, procurement, facilities, and other business systems in the office.
	+ Develop and maintain clear, accessible HR processes, documentation, workflows, and communication channels that equitably support staff productivity, clarity, and engagement.
	+ Partner with senior leaders to address personnel matters, support conflict resolution, and promote consistent, equitable application of policies and workplace expectations.
	+ Ensure the Mayor’s Office maintains compliance with City policies, labor agreements, and legal obligations related to personnel, workplace safety, and employment practices.
	+ Ensure the Mayor’s Office is actively building an equitable workplace through hiring process, HR policy, and practice.
* Collaborating with SHR and Labor Relations on behalf of Mayor Wilson:
	+ Act as the primary liaison between the Mayor’s Office and Seattle Human Resources (SHR), ensuring seamless coordination on hiring, personnel processes, HR compliance, and day\-to\-day HR operations.
	+ Serve as the Mayor’s Office liaison to SHR’s Labor Relations team, including coordination of, and participation as a voting member of the Executive Labor Committee and participation in the Labor Relations Policy Committee, which sets parameters for bargaining with City Unions, ensuring the office’s interests and obligations are clearly communicated and upheld.
* Building a connection between the Mayor’s Office and City employees in partnership with SHR:
	+ Partner with the communications team to build a strong program for Mayor’s Office communication to City Employees.
	+ Work closely with the SHR Director to bring a cohesive voice to the City from the Mayor’s Office, communicating clearly and often with City employees about ongoing and upcoming events and priorities.
	+ Act as the Mayor’s lens for employee impact with every major decision.
	+ Lead or support special projects, workforce initiatives, policy updates, or organizational improvements as assigned by the Mayor or Chief of Staff.

**Qualifications**
------------------


In addition to the ability to perform the tasks described above, you’ll be most prepared to successfully take on this role with a combination of the following:* Experience**:**
	+ Human Resources and people operations experience, particularly in a public sector setting
	+ Labor relations and the context of public sector contracts and bargaining
	+ Organizational leadership
	+ Managing a budget, particularly in a municipal finance setting
	+ Strong understanding of HR policies, labor agreements, workforce planning, and organizational development practices
	+ Negotiating contracts, MOUs, or staffing agreements within large or unionized environments

	+ Working independently, anticipating organizational needs

title: Corporate Human Resources & Accounting Business Partner
description:
**Position:** Corporate Human Resources \& Accounting Business Partner
**Company:** Columbia Safety Services, LLC
**Location:** Seattle, WA — in\-office during training, then hybrid with up to two days per week remote
**Reports To:** Controller
**Employment Type:** Full\-time, salaried, exempt
**Bargaining Unit Status:** Non\-union
**Incentive Eligibility:** Not commission or incentive eligible; see Compensation
**Travel:** Minimal — occasional travel to branch offices  


**About Columbia Safety Services**

Columbia Safety Services is the corporate support team for a growing group of fire and life safety businesses across the Pacific Northwest and Intermountain West:


* Columbia Fire, LLC — Seattle, WA
* Valley Fire Control, LLC — Albany and Newport, OR \+ Spokane, WA
* FFF Protection — Greater Boise, with an office in Nampa, ID

  



Our companies design, install, inspect, and service fire sprinkler systems, fire alarm systems, suppression systems, portable extinguishers, and the life safety equipment that protects people and property. Columbia Fire has served the Seattle market since 2005\. We are a multi\-state regional company growing both organically and through acquisition, and we are building efficient, scalable financial and people operations as we expand.  



Our core values guide how we operate: Customer First, Grit, Effective Communication, Own the Outcome, Take Pride in the Work, and Do the Right Thing.  


**Why This Role Exists**

We now run payroll, benefits, onboarding, and accounting for multiple companies across three states, and both functions sit with a small corporate team that is stretched thin. Certified payroll filings, 401(k) uploads, benefit enrollments, bank reconciliations, sales tax returns, and month\-end close all land on the same few desks.  



That does not hold as we keep acquiring companies. Every acquisition adds employees, a payroll register, a benefits population, a set of business licenses, and another general ledger to reconcile.  



This seat exists to take real ownership of both halves — the people side and the accounting side — so the corporate team can operate ahead of the business instead of catching up to it.  


**The Opportunity**
**This is a genuinely hybrid role, and we want to be direct about that.**

Roughly half of this job is human resources administration and roughly half is corporate accounting. You will be the person an employee comes to with a benefits question, and the person reconciling the bank in Acumatica.  



That combination is unusual, and it is deliberate. In a multi\-entity company our size the two functions touch constantly — payroll journal entries, benefit accruals, workers’ compensation audits, certified payroll. Someone who understands both does the work better than two people who each understand one.  



You will report to the Controller, work closely with the accounting team, and have real influence over how these processes get built as we scale.  


**Human Resources Responsibilities**


* Serve as the primary point of contact for employees on HR policies, procedures, and employment\-related questions
* Coordinate full\-cycle onboarding, including new hire paperwork, orientation, system setup, and benefits enrollment
* Manage 401(k) enrollments and weekly contribution uploads
* Coordinate offboarding, including exit interviews, final documentation, and system access removal
* Maintain employee personnel files and HRIS records with accuracy, completeness, and confidentiality
* Administer employee benefit programs — new enrollments, qualifying life events, annual open enrollment, and coordination with providers
* Provide backup support for payroll processing, reviewing employee changes, deductions, benefit elections, PTO balances, and payroll audits
* Assist with weekly certified payroll filings
* Coordinate the annual performance review process with managers and maintain documentation
* Support recruiting with job postings, applicant screening, interview scheduling, and candidate communication
* Maintain recruiting platforms and the Applicant Tracking System
* Track employee certifications, licenses, required training, and compliance deadlines across multiple states and jurisdictions
* Coordinate employee recognition, wellness, and engagement initiatives
* Help maintain HR policies and the employee handbook
* Support annual workers’ compensation audits and respond to auditors and regulatory agencies

  


**Corporate Accounting Responsibilities**


* Manage daily bank transaction matching and bank reconciliations in Acumatica
* Process and record daily cash receipts
* Prepare and file monthly and quarterly city and state sales tax returns
* Manage business license renewals and regulatory compliance
* Coordinate vehicle registrations, fleet records, and related compliance requirements
* Support the monthly financial close
* Prepare and post general ledger and payroll\-related journal entries
* Reconcile assigned balance sheet accounts and investigate reconciling items
* Support special accounting projects and process improvement work

  


**Systems \& Process Improvement**


* Serve as our internal subject matter expert for WorkForce Go, including HRIS, payroll, timekeeping, and applicant tracking
* Identify and implement improvements to HR and accounting workflows rather than absorbing their inefficiencies
* Use AI and automation tools where they genuinely reduce manual work, and document what you build so the improvement outlasts you
* Support HR and accounting systems work through acquisitions and integrations

**Who You Are**


* Detail\-oriented — payroll and reconciliations punish approximation
* Organized across two functions with competing deadlines
* Proactive — you flag a problem before it becomes a correction
* Discreet — you will hold confidential employee and financial information every day
* Approachable — employees have to feel comfortable bringing you a question
* Willing to engage conflict — you address issues directly and early
* Self\-directed — you manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision
* Aligned with our values: Customer First, Grit, Effective Communication, Own the Outcome, Take Pride in the Work, and Do the Right Thing

  


**Who Struggles Here**

An honest filter, because this seat asks for two skill sets:


* If you want to specialize in one function, this role will pull you in two directions every week
* If you need a fully documented process to follow, a good deal of this is yours to build
* If holding confidential information is difficult for you, this is the wrong seat
* If month\-end close landing on top of open enrollment would rattle you, know that it happens here
* If you would rather send an email than have the conversation, the HR half will be the harder one

  


**Minimum Qualifications**


* Five or more years of combined accounting and human resources experience
* Experience supporting payroll administration and HRIS systems
* Experience with general ledger work, journal entries, and account reconciliation
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, payroll software, and ERP systems
* Demonstrated ability to maintain strict confidentiality with employee and financial information
* Strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to build working relationships at every level of the organization
* Residence in the Greater Seattle area, or willingness to relocate before your start date
* Fluent in spoken and written English
* Ability to pass a background check and pre\-employment drug screen

  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, human resources, business administration, or a related field
* Acumatica experience
* WorkForce Go experience
* Certified payroll and prevailing wage filing experience
* Multi\-entity or multi\-state payroll and accounting experience
* Construction, field service, or project\-based industry experience
* Experience supporting acquisitions or system integrations
* SHRM\-CP, PHR, or a comparable human resources credential
* Experience at a small or mid\-sized company where you carried a broad range of responsibilities

  


**Compensation**


* Base salary: $90,000 – $110,000 annually, depending on experience and demonstrated capability
* Classification: full\-time, salaried, exempt
* This role is not commission or incentive eligible. Discretionary bonus consideration may apply based on company and individual performance; bonuses are not guaranteed.

  



The upper end of this range is for candidates who bring genuine depth in both accounting and human resources, along with multi\-entity or multi\-state experience.

**Why This Role Works**


* Real ownership across two functions instead of a narrow lane
* Direct access to the Controller and the executive team
* You build the processes rather than inherit finished ones
* Multi\-entity, multi\-state work that keeps expanding through acquisition
* Paid credentials and continuing education in both disciplines
* Backed by a multi\-state regional fire protection group focused on the long term

  


**Benefits**


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance through Regence BlueShield, Delta Dental of Washington, and VSP — available to employees scheduled 30 or more hours per week, effective the first of the month following or coinciding with your hire date
* The company pays approximately 90% of the employee premium on the HSA\-qualified medical plan, plus a substantial share of dependent premiums
* Health Savings Account with a $600 annual company contribution
* 401(k) with Safe Harbor employer match up to 3\.5%
* Paid time off starting at 10 days annually and increasing with length of service
* Eight paid holidays
* Company\-paid basic life and AD\&D insurance
* Employee Assistance Program, telehealth access, and optional pet insurance
* Paid training, certifications, and continuing education
* Company laptop and technology package
* Paid training, certifications, and continuing education, including HR credentials

  


**Schedule \& Work Environment**


* Full\-time, Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week, based in our Seattle office
* In\-office during the initial training period, then hybrid with up to two days per week remote
* Standard business hours, with additional hours around payroll cycles, month\-end close, and open enrollment
* Primarily office\-based with extended computer use and occasional light lifting of files and supplies
* Occasional travel to branch offices

  


**Apply**

If you are strong in both accounting and human resources, and you would rather build the process than work around it, we want to talk.  



Columbia Safety Services, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.  



Employment with Columbia Safety Services, LLC is at\-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice, consistent with applicable law.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**Company Description** **A LITTLE ABOUT US:**


At Dungarvin, we are more than a provider of support services; we’re a mission\-driven team rooted in respect, inclusion, and person\-centered care. Since 1976, we’ve been dedicated to enhancing the quality of life for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities, including those with mental health, behavioral, or complex medical needs.


Our mission is simple but powerful: respecting and responding to the choices of people in need of supports. This mission guides everything we do; from creating individualized service plans to building strong partnerships with families, teams, and communities.


As a Dungarvin employee, you’ll be at the heart of that mission. You’ll help people live meaningful lives on their own terms; supporting their goals, honoring their choices, and empowering their independence.


With services nationwide, our team is united by a shared commitment to making a real difference; one person, one voice, one choice at a time.


Join our nationwide family and let us help you achieve your unique goals and dreams.

**WE OFFER:**

* **Compensation**: $ 34\.60 Hourly Fixed Rate
* **Work Environment:** Hybrid (2\-3 Days in office in Tacoma WA )
* **Team Culture:** A highly collaborative and dependable team that works closely together, stays engaged, and values trust, accountability, and steady leadership while consistently delivering for the business and the people we serve.
* **Work Schedule:** Typically, 8 AM – 5 PM PST, with flexibility as needed to meet deadlines or support initiatives
* **Retirement Plan:** 401 K plan with employer match after one year of service.
* **Time Away:** PTO that increases with tenure, PTO donation options, and paid sick leave
* **Company\-Provided Hardware and Cellphone Stipend:** All necessary equipment will be provided, along with a monthly stipend for cell phone expenses.
* **Insurance \& Health:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage (including plans for families, spouses, and domestic partners). Additional benefits include pet insurance, supplemental insurance options. Plus, 100% company\-paid long\-term disability and life insurance.
* **Employee Perks:** National Brand Discounts, Employee Referral Program, and Employee Assistance Program
* **Job Mobility:** Dungarvin’s multi\-state footprint allows internal job mobility nationwide.
* **Mileage Reimbursement:** $0\.50 cents per mile

 **Job Description**  

As a **Human Resources Business Partner**, you’ll sit right in the middle of the work that matters most supporting leaders in real time as they navigate people decisions, employee relations issues, and day\-to\-day workforce challenges. As a trusted HR advisor you will help guide state and operations leaders across Washington , as situations unfold. You’ll drive HR strategies in a practical, people\-centered way coaching leaders through employee relations and performance conversations, managing investigations, and helping ensure consistency, fairness, and compliance across the region. You’ll also support workforce planning and use data and insight to help leaders make decisions that strengthen both performance and retention. In this role, you’ll help ensure leaders feel supported, employees feel heard, and teams feel connected to both the work and the mission in a meaningful way.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

**HR Business Partnership:** Build trusted relationships with leaders and employees across your business units, serving as a strategic advisor on employee relations, performance management, team development, and organizational change. Partner with leaders to navigate complex situations, strengthen team effectiveness, and drive positive business outcomes.

**Employee Relations \& Compliance:** Lead workplace investigations, manage employee relations matters, track trends and grievances, and provide practical, compliant recommendations that balance business needs with the employee experience.

**Leadership Onboarding \& Development:** Support the successful onboarding of new leaders by providing guidance on HR policies, benefits, compliance, and people practices while coaching managers to build high\-performing, engaged teams.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with HR Centers of Excellence and cross\-functional teams to deliver consistent, proactive, and solution\-oriented HR support that enhances the employee experience and supports organizational goals.

 **Qualifications** **MUST HAVE:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
* **HRBP Experience:** 3\+ years of HR Business Partner experience supporting large, non\-exempt populations.
* **HR Knowledge \& Expertise:** Strong knowledge of employee relations, performance management, and compensation, with experience across core HR functions, including high\-volume recruiting and organizational development, and skills in investigations, coaching, employee development, and change/project management.
* **Microsoft 365 \& Power BI: Proficiency:** Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint), with the ability to analyze data and present actionable insights; Power BI experience a plus.
* **HR Compliance:** Strong knowledge of federal and state employment laws, multi\-state compliance, and diversity \& inclusion.

**NICE TO HAVE:**

* **HR Leadership:** Ability to influence and support leaders through coaching and performance management; prior leadership or mentoring experience is a plus, especially when partnering with operations.
* **HR Technology Expertise:** Experience with HRIS platforms such as Workday, UltiPro (Ultimate Software), or similar systems, along with familiarity with ATS and LMS platforms (e.g., Relias, Cornerstone).
* **Industry Experience:** Background in healthcare, human services, or other regulated, multi\-state environments preferred.
* **Professional Certifications:** SHRM\-CP, SHRM\-SCP, PHR, or SPHR.
* **Additional credentials:** In Coaching, Mediation, or Project Management (PMP, CAPM)

  

**Additional Information** **SKILLS CRITICAL FOR SUCCESS:**

* **Strategic \& Analytical Thinking:** Connects people strategy to business goals, uses data and insights to assess workforce trends, and makes sound decisions aligned with company values and strategy.
* **Relationship Building \& Influence:** Builds trust quickly, fosters collaboration, coaches leaders, and communicates HR guidance clearly to employees and management.
* **Emotional Intelligence \& Problem Solving:** Navigates sensitive situations with professionalism and empathy, resolves conflicts constructively, and brings innovative solutions to complex workforce challenges.
* **Adaptability \& Change Agility:** Thrives in fast\-paced, evolving environments, supporting others through transitions while maintaining focus on outcomes and continuous improvement.
* **Leadership \& Coaching:** Partners with leaders to mentor and develop teams, promoting engagement, accountability, and a high\-performance culture.
* **Organization \& Project Management:** Manages multiple priorities and initiatives across business units with attention to detail, efficiency, and accuracy.
* **Compliance \& Integrity:** Ensures adherence to employment laws, regulations, and company policies while maintaining confidentiality and credibility.
* **Technical \& HR Systems Proficiency:** Leverages HR technology to streamline processes, improve decision\-making, and enhance workforce management.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE THIS ROLE:**


If you’re a people\-focused professional, this role lets you make a real impact. You’ll partner with leaders to shape culture, strengthen teams, and drive business outcomes through people\-centered strategies. Join a collaborative HR team that values innovation, learning, and genuine connection. You’ll be the person leaders turn to when situations are complex, unclear, or sensitive, and your guidance will directly influence how teams are supported, how issues are resolved, and how leaders grow. No two days look the same, and the work is always tied to real people and real outcomes.

title: Senior Human Resources Analyst - Limited Term
description:
**Description**
---------------


The **City of Tukwila** is seeking a **Senior Human Resources Analyst** for a 6\-month limited term assignment. We are a small team of 4 serving an employee population of over 300 employees. We work with 3 unions and have 8 bargaining units. The Senior Human Resources Analyst will work closely with the Deputy HR Director in working with the unions, conducting investigations, guiding management staff, writing policies and procedures, and performing leave management activities.


The role is term\-limited for a period of six months and will be offered benefits.


Qualified candidates will have experience in supporting labor, employee relations, classification \& compensation, and leave management. We are looking for a highly engaged, hands\-on human resources professional who embodies the City of Tukwila values to include Caring, Professionalism and Responsiveness.

 **About the City**
The City of Tukwila is 9\.6 square miles of opportunity and a dynamic place to work. The population is over 22,000 at night and up to 150,000\+ during the day. Tukwila shares borders with the Cities of Seattle, Renton, SeaTac, Burien, and Kent. Its central location lies in the heart of the Puget Sound region, sitting 12 miles south of downtown Seattle, 17 miles north of downtown Tacoma, and just east of SeaTac Airport. It is easily accessed by I\-5 and I\-405 or via either of Tukwila’s two train stations, the Sounder Station or the Sound Transit Light Rail Station. **Our Mission:**To provide superior services that support a safe, inviting, healthy environment for our residents, businesses and guests.

**Our Values:**

* **Caring –** We support the diverse community we serve with compassion, empathy and kindness.
* **Professional –** We hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards and act with integrity and transparency. We are respectful and courteous with all.
* **Responsive –** We are timely and effective in the delivery of great customer service. We continually strive to find innovative ways to improve.

 **Salary range:** $9,000 \- $12,000 monthly
Note: We don’t typically start at the top of the salary schedule. ***The position will remain open until filled with first review of applications on August 10, 2026\.*****How to Apply:**


Initial screening will be based solely on the contents and completeness of the "education" and "work experience" section of your application in the governmentjobs.com website. In order to be considered for this position you MUST apply online and complete the entire application. A Cover Letter and Resume are highly encouraged.  

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**  

The City of Tukwila is an equal opportunity employer and strives to employ a diverse workforce reflective of the community it serves. Qualified applicants with multicultural experience and/or backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply.  

  

**Veteran's Preference**:
The City of Tukwila follows the guidance given by the State of Washington regarding applying Veteran's Preference under provisions of RCW 73\.16\.010 and WAC 357\.16\.110 (2\). Please attach a copy of your DD214 or NGB Form 22 to your online application if you are eligible to claim Veterans Preference. Character of service should reflect as being Honorable. General discharge under Honorable Condition does not qualify. **Selection Process:**
This selection process may include but is not limited to: evaluation of application materials and supplemental questions, testing, and interviewing. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request to humanresources@tukwilawa.gov.
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------


* Supports departments with employee relations and engagement, policy interpretation, and coaching/performance management guidance.
* Facilitates the resolution of employee relation matters serving as an internal consultant for employees and leaders while demonstrating sensitivity, fairness, confidentiality and maintaining legally sound practices.
* Manages and resolves complex employee relations matters; conducts effective, thorough and objective investigations, reporting findings and making recommendations.
* Manage, track and coordinate responses to grievances and discipline within CBA timelines as needed
* Communicate with employees regarding their FMLA rights and responsibilities and ensure compliance of the Family Medical Leave Act (FMLA) and other federal and state regulations and leave programs.
* Perform job audits and analyses of individual positions; recommend reclassifications; develop new or revised job classifications with employees and supervisors.
* Assist Deputy Human Resource Director in contract negotiation research, writing and proofing of contract language, and may sit at collective bargaining table during negotiations
* Research legal requirements and may develop or assist in the development of compliance policies.
* Maintain confidentiality of sensitive and confidential materials.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**
-----------------------------------


**Knowledge of:**

* Principles and practices of public human resources administration including employee relations, labor relations, investigations, performance management, recruitment and selection, classification and compensation, job analysis, benefits administration, and training.
* All applicable federal, state and local laws, rules and regulations pertaining to public human resources administration, such as FLSA, leave laws, ADA, Civil Service requirements, and all applicable labor contracts.
* Job analysis methods and techniques.
* Statistical and research methods.
* Windows based computer systems.

**Ability to:**

* Provide professional human resources services independently with limited direction, exercising discretion and reasonable judgement.
* Interpret, apply and explain rules, regulations, policies, and procedures.
* Conduct research, read, interpret and analyze complex facts and issues; evaluate alternatives, and recommend solutions and/or innovative new approaches based on findings.
* Listen effectively and explain complex issues and applicable legal requirements, policies, and procedures to internal and external customers.
* Perform job analysis, position audits and other research.
* Write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles; can get messages across that initiate appropriate actions.
* Communicate effectively in order to take direction, provide consultation, justify recommendations, conduct training, deliver public presentations, and other related tasks.
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with co\-workers, city staff, and the public.
* Provide excellent customer service, in sometimes stressful situations, to internal and external customers.
* Prepare reports, correspondence, forms, questionnaires and surveys.
* Effectively handle multiple assignments while maintaining accuracy of information and meeting deadlines.
* Maintain confidentiality of business records and other information.
* Use all office equipment proficiently including windows\-based personal computers and related software applications that support the human resource management function.
* Maintain regular and reliable attendance.

**Education, Experience and Other Requirements**
------------------------------------------------


**Required:** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Labor Law, Public Policy or a related field, and four (4\) years of related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience to provide sufficient evidence of the successful performance of the essential elements of the job such as those listed above. Experience in Public Sector Human Resources preferred.

* Valid Driver's License.
* Must be fingerprinted and pass a background check prior to hire.

  
The **City of Tukwila** offers a comprehensive benefit package to all regular full\-time and part\-time employees and their eligible dependents, including domestic partners (DP) and their dependents (a tax penalty applies to the DP portion of the premium). Part\-time employees pay a pro\-rated share of the premium. **Medical** Employees have the option of choosing from the City's self\-insured plan that is administered by **Healthcare Management Administrators (HMA)** and is part of the Regence Preferred Provider network; or **Kaiser Permanente**, an HMO, for medical and prescription coverage. **Dental** The dental plan is provided through the City's self\-insured plan (HMA) and covers preventative, basic, and restorative services to an annual maximum of $2,000\. An incentive level applies to these services ranging from 70% to 100% coverage. Orthodontia is available for dependent children to age 19\.

The Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) serves as a strategic and operational partner across assigned regions, providing expert guidance in employee relations, labor relations, HR compliance, and workplace strategy. This role is responsible for managing complex employee issues, conducting workplace investigations, supporting a union environment, and driving initiatives related to retention, performance and organizational effectiveness across a multi\-state workforce. The HRBP works closely with employees, leaders and HR partners to ensure consistent, equitable, and compliant practices while proactively using data and insights to improve employee experience and reduce organizational risk.

Serve as the primary HR advisor for assigned region, providing guidance on employee relations, performance concerns, and corrective actions.
  
* Coach managers on addressing employee issues proactively to reduce risk and improve outcomes.
* Support and guide corrective action processes, ensuring consistency, fairness, and documentation integrity.
* Respond to and resolve employee concerns with a focus on timely, compliance and thoughtful resolution.
* Conduct thorough, impartial workplace investigations.
* Gather and analyze information, interview involved parties, and document findings.
* Provide recommendations and partner with leadership on appropriate outcomes.
* Ensure investigations meet legal and organizational standards.
* Support employees and leaders in a union environment by applying the collective bargaining agreement (CBA).
* Assist with grievance processes, corrective actions, and investigations involving union employees.
* Partner in labor\-management processes and meetings, as needed.
* Analyze turnover trends and identify root causes across regions, departments and employee groups.
* Partner with leaders to develop and implement retention strategies.
* Utilize HR data and metrics to identify risks and implement proactive solutions.
* Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, satisfaction, and workforce stability


Support the implementation of continuous improvement of the performance management process.
  
* Coach managers on goal setting, feedback, and performance conversations.
* Partner on performance improvement plans and ensure consistency across the organization.
* Identify trends in performance outcomes and recommend enhancements.


Support the development and extension of salary offers in partnership with Talent Acquisition and leaders.
  
* Ensure offers are competitive, equitable, and aligned with internal pay structure.
* Provide guidance on compensation decisions, including pay equity and compression considerations.


Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws across employee worked and lived in states.
  
* Monitor regulatory changes and advise leadership on impact.
* Support the development, review and update of HR policies.
* Ensure the accurate and consistent interpretation and application of HR policies across the organization


Partner with organizational stakeholders to support a positive, consistent, and high\[1]quality employee experience.
  
* Work cross\-functionally with HR team members to ensure alignment, consistency, and effective service delivery.
* Use data and insights to inform recommendations and influence decision\-making at the leadership level.
* Contribute to HR initiatives that strengthen culture, engagement and organizational effectiveness.
* Identify training needs, recommend and facilitate HR\-related training initiatives aligned with organizational objectives and workforce development priorities


**Minimum Qualifications:**  

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent of education and experience.
  
* Minimum of 3 years of progressive HR experience.
* Working knowledge of federal, state and local employment laws, including multi\-state compliance.
* Experience supporting both remote and onsite workforces across multiple locations.


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

HR certification (e.g., SHRM\-CP, PHR, SHRM\-SCP, SPHR).
  
* Experience supporting or working in a unionized healthcare environment.
* Experience conducting workplace investigations, including complex and sensitive matters.
* Experience supporting compensation decisions.


**Salary Range:**  

Washington $78,164\.00 \- $145,163\.00 Annually
  
Alaska $74,256\.00 \- $137,904\.00 Annually
  
Hawaii $70, 348\.00 \- $130,646\.00 Annually
  
Indiana, Idaho, Kentucky \- $66,439\. 00 \- $123,388\.00 Annually
  
  

**Position Type:**  

Full\-time
  
  

**Benefits Eligibility:**  

This position is eligible for PPGNHAIK benefits. As part of our total compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits plan including medical, dental and vision plans, retirement, paid time off, short and long\-term disability and life insurance. For additional information about our benefits program, please send an email to hre.contacts@ppgnhaik.org.
  
  

**Other Information:**  

All new hires are strongly recommended to have the COVID\-19 vaccination, including boosters. All new hires hired between September and April must present proof of receiving a current flu shot.
  
What we expect from you.
  
* That you adhere to our code of conduct, policies, procedures, and protocols.
* That you always demonstrate a high degree of professionalism.
* That you always support and model our customer service standards.
* That you value continuous learning and seek ongoing training and development.


**Our commitment to diversity:**  

At PPGNHAIK, we’ve outlined our priorities and goals as we continue to cultivate and promote a diverse, equitable, \& inclusive culture that champions dignity, care, and respect, and where employees feel welcomed and motivated to do their best. These priorities reflect our promise to support programs and initiatives that promote continuous learning and organizational development and discussions on DEI topics; provide internal developmental opportunities; and assess what more we can do to nurture a supportive and equitable work environment.

The Starting Hourly Rate / Salario por Hora Inicial is $19\.00 USD per hour. The Pay Range / Rango salarial is $19\.00 USD \- $28\.50 USD per hour.**ALL ABOUT TARGET**


Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

 **ALL ABOUT HUMAN RESOURCES**


You are a team that champions change, proactively removes roadblocks and builds diverse and inclusive talent strategies to deliver on our guest centric mission. You are part of a Human Resource (HR) team who are committed to supporting teams and leaders to build a sales force that is passionate about exceeding guests’ expectations and a place where teams love to work.

 **At Target****,****we believe in our team members having meaningful experiences that help them build and develop skills for a career. The role of****a Human****Resources Expert can provide you with the****skills and experience of****:**

* Understanding federal, state and local employment laws
* Using basic Microsoft Office Suite computer and workforce management programs
* Effectively using scheduling software
 **As a Human Resources Expert, no two days****are ever the same, but a typical day will****most likely include****the following responsibilities:**

* Create an Easy, Inspiring and Friendly guest experience by delivering on the following commitments:
* Greet:
* 10ft: be friendly – smile, make eye contact, or wave
* 4ft: greet the guest, smile and initiate a warm, helpful interaction
* Help guests find what they need and/or resolve issues to ensure a smooth, easy shopping experience
* End every guest transaction with a sincere thank you
* Actively support team efforts and assist peers in other areas while maintaining a positive and respectful attitude
* Adjust to business and guest needs to deliver an easy and inspiring guest experience
* Work with your HR leader to anticipate and address specific talent and staffing needs for each area of the business; this includes understanding guests’ needs and ensuring the right mix of experience and skills to deliver on the in\-store and digital shopping experiences.
* Lead focused recruiting efforts to help store leaders find and hire candidates.
* Support team member and leader training needs and be an advocate for continuous learning.
* Be an expert resource for scheduling systems and pay practices.
* Be approachable and available by listening to team members and collaborate with appropriate leaders to take action as needed.
* Deliver on all Human Resources processes and programs to maximize team member engagement and minimize business disruption.
* Support your leader in following company compliance policies that mitigate risk to the team member experience.
* Demonstrate a culture of ethical conduct, safety and compliance.
* Work in a safe manner at all times; comply with all safety policies, best practices, and training; report hazards and correct where possible.
* All other duties based on business needs.
 **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

 **This m****ay****be the right job for you if:**

* You enjoy interacting and helping others \- including guests that shop our store and fellow team members you work with.
* You thrive in a fast\-moving, highly active and physically demanding role, where teamwork, flexibility, and creative problem solving are key to success.
* You are open to working a flexible work schedule with varying hours, days or shifts (including nights, weekends, holidays and other peak shopping times).
 **The good news is that we have some amazing training that will help teach you everything you need to know to be a****Human Resources Expert****. But****there are a few skills you should have from the get\-go:**

* Welcoming and helpful attitude toward all guests and other team members
* Ability to communicate on multiple frequency devices and operate handheld scanners, and other technology equipment as directed.
* Effective communication skills
* Work both independently and with a team
* Resolve guest questions quickly on the spot
* Attention to detail and follow multi\-step processes
* Capability to remain focused and composed in a fast\-paced environment and accomplish multiple tasks within established timeframes
 **We are an awesome place to work and care about our teams, so we want to make sure we are clear on a few more basics****that****we expect:**

* Accurately handle cash register operations as needed.
* Frequently lifting or moving merchandise up to 10 pounds and occasionally lifting or moving merchandise up to 44 pounds, without additional assistance from others.
* Capable of working in and exposure to varying temperatures, humidity, and other elements while performing certain job duties including but not limited to Drive\-Up, carryout, etc.
* Ability to remain mobile for the duration of a scheduled shift (shift length may vary).
* Flexible work schedule (e.g., nights, weekends and holidays); come to work when scheduled, work scheduled shifts and take required meal and rest breaks

**Job Description:**  

At Tacoma Screw Products, we believe our employees are the foundation of our success. We are looking for an organized, dependable Human Resources Assistant who enjoys supporting people, keeping projects on track, and ensuring the details are handled with care, confidentiality and accuracy. This role is ideal for someone who takes pride in exceptional administrative work, enjoys helping others, and wants to be part of a collaborative HR team.


If you enjoy bringing order to busy days, helping people, creating great employee experiences, and taking pride in getting the details right, this position offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact while building a career in Human Resources.


The Human Resources Assistant provides administrative support for the daily operations of the Human Resources department. The position coordinates recruiting, onboarding, employee records, benefits administration, travel, safety documentation, employee communications, engagement activities, and community outreach. Success in this role comes from strong organization, attention to detail, professionalism, confidentiality and outstanding customer service.  

**Experience and Skills:**

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Maintain accurate and confidential employee files and HR records.
* Coordinate recruiting activities including posting positions, scheduling interviews, communicating with candidates, and preparing hiring paperwork.
* Coordinate new hire onboarding and employee separation processes.
* Assist employees with benefits enrollment, changes, and general HR questions.
* Maintain HRIS records and personnel documentation.
* Assist with administration of the company safety program by maintaining training records, safety documentation, and required reporting.
* Coordinate employee recognition activities, holiday events, wellness initiatives, charitable drives, etc.
* Prepare correspondence, reports, presentations, and other HR documents.
* Provide friendly, responsive customer service to internal and external partners.
* Maintain strict confidentiality while handling sensitive employee information.
* Support the HR Director with special projects and other administrative duties as assigned.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Employees receive timely, professional service.
* Recruiting and onboarding processes run smoothly.
* Personnel records remain accurate and audit\-ready.
* Administrative details are completed consistently and on time.
* Employee engagement activities are well organized.

**Qualifications:**

* Associate's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
* One to three years of administrative, HR, office, or customer service experience preferred.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise good judgment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams); ability to learn HRIS systems quickly.

  

**Job Benefits:**
Pay Range: $24\.00–$30\.00 per hour.


Discretionary year\-end bonus opportunity.


After 90 days of employment, employees are eligible to participate in the following benefit programs:


* 100% of premiums company paid for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance for you and your eligible dependents. Meaning there are no payroll deductions from employee’s paychecks to cover insurance premiums.
* 401K with a 3% Company Match – Helping you plan for the future with employer contributions.
* Company\-Paid Life Insurance, AD\&D, Short and Long\-Term Disability – Providing security and peace of mind at no cost to you.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential support for personal and professional challenges.


We recognize the importance of rest and personal time. Our time\-off benefits include:


* 7 Paid Holidays, plus Half Days on Christmas Eve \& New Year’s Eve
* 5 Paid Personal Days during your first year
* Paid Sick Leave
* Vacation Accrual Begins After One Year

**Additional Details:**


The job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job; this is not all inclusive. There may be additional tasks, responsibilities, and qualifications for this job.


*Tacoma Screw Products is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or age.*


For more information about our commitment to equal employment opportunity, please see this government poster: Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal.


If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation in the application or hiring process, please contact Human Resources at 253\-572\-3444 or humanresources@tacomascrew.com
