title: Senior Human Resources Consultant
description:
**Description**
---------------

  

  

**Washington State House of Representatives**
Exempt Recruitment Announcement **Senior Human Resources Consultant** **OPENS***:*  

July 31, 2026 **CLOSES:**  

August 14, 2026 **REPORTSTO**:  

Human Resources Director **LOCATION**:  

Thurston County \- Olympia, Washington **SALARY**:  

$86,136 \- $149,280 annually  

State law requires us to post the full salary range; however, individual salary is determined based on experience and internal alignment. Most applicants will start below the top of the range.  

The anticipated hire date is October 01, 2026\. **About the House of Representatives:**
The House of Representatives (House) comprises half of the Washington State Legislature and is made up of 98 members elected to serve two\-year terms, representing 49 legislative districts. The House employs approximately 240 full\-time year\-round staff and 100 temporary session staff and interns. Staff workgroups include, nonpartisan staff, Democratic Caucus staff and Republican Caucus staff. The Legislature meets annually on the second Monday in January on the capitol campus in Olympia. Regular legislative sessions take place January through March in even\-numbered years and January through April in odd\-numbered years. Special legislative sessions occur as needed.  

Our workplace is on the beautiful capitol campus in Olympia. The 486\-acre campus includes the Legislative Building and other historic structures, as well as popular parks and trails with views of Capitol Lake, Budd Inlet, and the Olympic Mountains.  

The House of Representatives holds themselves to the Legislative Code of Conduct which expects the following:* We conduct ourselves with self\-awareness, self\-respect, and professionalism;
* We treat others with respect, dignity, and civility, regardless of status or position; and
* We refrain from engaging in hostile, intimidating, offensive, or unlawful activities or behaviors that may amount to discrimination, harassment, sexual harassment, or bullying.

**Duties**
----------


**Position Profile:**
This position provides support to the HR Director serving as back\-up in their absence. This position provides expert level consultation to Members and staff on matters of employee relations and human resource matters involving policy, investigations, and appropriate workplace conduct. **How You’ll Be Expected to Contribute:*** Consult on human resources matters with staff directors, supervisors, and employees.
* Coordinate with the Senate and legislative agencies on external ADA process and accessibility of legislative proceedings, publications, websites, and communications.
* Collaborate with the Office of Program Research, communications staff, and member offices on language access and providing interpretation and translation services.
* Provide support, coaching, and conflict resolution for employees and Members involved in workplace conflicts.
* Consult on recruitment and selection strategies, new employee orientation, and employee performance success.
* Facilitate New Employee Orientation and New Supervisor Orientation.
* Conduct interviews, gather materials and evidence, and write investigative reports on complaints.
* Support collective bargaining needs; i.e., negotiations, data analysis, and grievance hearings.
* Update, organize, and maintain job classification descriptions and HR procedures.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
------------------


**The Successful Candidate Will Meet These Qualifications:****Knowledge**:* Five or more years of professional level generalist HR consultant experience.
 **Skills:*** Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with others.
* Demonstrated experience engaging in and facilitating difficult conversations with staff and supervisors/managers (conflict resolution/mediation).
* Demonstrated experience in conducting investigations in the areas of workplace policies, including allegations of discrimination and harassment, interviews, investigative analysis, and production of investigative documentation.
* Demonstrated experience independently managing multiple responsibilities at the same time.
* Demonstrated experience communicating effectively verbally and in writing.
* Demonstrated strong critical thinking and decision\-making.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and related software.
 **Abilities:*** Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.
* Demonstrated ability to foster an environment that is inclusive and welcoming to all.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and implement incremental improvements to create efficiencies.
 **Desirable/Preferred Qualifications:*** Experience working in the public sector.
* Experience interpreting and applying collective bargaining agreement contracts, rules, and statutes.
* Supervisory or lead experience.
* Professional in Human Resources (PHR) or Senior Professional in Human Resources (SPHR) certification.

 *Note:Diverse backgrounds in education and experience could be successful in this role and will be considered. Candidates with any combination of experience that demonstrates the ability to perform the work will be considered****.***
**Supplemental Information**
----------------------------


**Conditions of Employment/Working Conditions**:
This position requires an onsite/in\-person presence in Olympia during session and must be able to frequently work more than 40 hours per week including evenings, weekends, and holidays during legislative sessions. Interim schedules allow for more flexibility including in\-state telework with an expectation to have an onsite in\-person presence when requested. **Benefits:**
Employee benefits include vacation and sick leave; paid state holidays; health, life, and other optional insurance; retirement; social security; and military leave. **How to Apply:**
Intrigued? If so, please submit the below items *combined in one document*:
(1\) a **letter of interest** specifically addressing the qualifications;
(2\) a **current resume** describing in detail your experience and education; and
(3\) a minimum of three **professional references,** including at least one supervisor, with contact information (e.g., address, e\-mail address, and telephone). **Send application materials and direct any questions to:** **HouseHR@leg.wa.gov****.**  


The Washington State Legislature is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, religion, creed, color, national origin, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, honorably discharged veteran, or military status, or using a trained service animal by a person with a disability. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply, including those listed above and those with other diverse life experiences. Persons requiring reasonable accommodation in the application process or requiring information in an alternative format may contact House HR Director at HouseHR@leg.wa.gov or 360\-786\-7030, or TTD 1\-800\-635\-9993\. Those with a hearing impairment in need of accommodation are encouraged to contact the Washington Relay Service at 1\-800\-676\-3777 or www.washingtonrelay.com.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Human Resources Manager**

**Company:** Inventech Marine Solutions / Life Proof Boats  
**Location:** Bremerton, WA (On\-Site)  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Compensation:** $65,000 – $75,000 DOE, plus performance bonus potential

**About Us**

Inventech Marine Solutions, the builder of Life Proof Boats, is a growing aluminum boat manufacturer serving commercial, government, military, and recreational marine markets. We recently moved into a new manufacturing facility and continue to scale production capacity and headcount.

Our team currently spans welding and fabrication, rigging, engineering, finishing, upholstery, collars, purchasing, and administration — and we are growing. As we scale, we need an HR professional who can bring structure, consistency, and a people\-first approach to our HR function.

**Position Summary**

The Human Resources Manager will own the HR function at IMS — from recruiting and onboarding through compliance, benefits administration, employee relations, and policy development. This is a hands\-on, generalist role suited for someone who can operate both strategically and tactically in a fast\-moving manufacturing environment.

The right candidate is approachable to shop\-floor employees, credible with management, comfortable with both white\-collar and blue\-collar workforce dynamics, and capable of building HR systems that support a growing team without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.

This is not a support role. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the HR function and helps IMS become a better place to work while enabling the business to grow.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the full\-cycle recruiting process — job postings, sourcing, screening, interviewing, offers, and onboarding — for all hourly and salaried positions.
* Develop and maintain onboarding programs that get new hires productive and retained.
* Administer employee benefits programs including health insurance, 401(k), PTO, and other company\-provided benefits.
* Serve as the first point of contact for employee relations issues, workplace concerns, and conflict resolution.
* Ensure IMS remains in compliance with federal, Washington State, and local employment laws and regulations (WISHA, FLSA, FMLA, EEO, I\-9, etc.).
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR documentation, and personnel files.
* Develop, update, and enforce company HR policies, the employee handbook, and workplace conduct standards.
* Support department managers with performance management, corrective action, PIPs, and terminations.
* Coordinate and track employee training, certifications, and skills development.
* Build and maintain a skills matrix and training calendar in coordination with production leadership.
* Manage the separation process — exit interviews, offboarding, and unemployment responses.
* Support payroll coordination and ensure HR data accuracy.
* Identify and address turnover drivers, morale issues, and cultural gaps.
* Help build a positive, accountable, and respectful workplace culture aligned with IMS values.
* Partner with leadership on workforce planning as the company continues to grow.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Open positions are filled faster, with better\-fit candidates.
* New hires are onboarded consistently and feel set up to succeed.
* Managers have clear processes for addressing performance and conduct issues.
* IMS is in compliance with applicable employment law — no surprises.
* Employee questions about benefits, policies, and HR processes get answered quickly.
* Turnover is tracked, understood, and improving.
* The company has a real HR infrastructure — not just ad\-hoc responses.
* Employees trust HR as a fair and accessible resource.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4\+ years of HR generalist or HR manager experience, with demonstrated ownership of multiple HR functions.
* Experience in a manufacturing, trades, or industrial environment — understanding of blue\-collar workforce dynamics is essential.
* Strong knowledge of Washington State employment law, WISHA/OSHA requirements, and federal HR compliance.
* Experience managing full\-cycle recruiting for both hourly and salaried roles.
* Proficiency in benefits administration and employee relations.
* Hands\-on experience developing or updating HR policies and employee handbooks.
* Strong interpersonal skills — able to build trust with shop\-floor employees and senior leadership alike.
* Organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* High degree of discretion and professionalism in handling sensitive information.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SHRM\-CP, SHRM\-SCP, PHR, or SPHR certification.
* Experience in boatbuilding, marine manufacturing, defense manufacturing, or government contracting environments.
* Familiarity with ERP or HRIS systems.
* Experience supporting a workforce of 50–150 employees across multiple departments.
* Experience building HR infrastructure in a scaling or rapidly growing company.
* Background in workforce development, apprenticeship programs, or skills\-based training programs.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a practical, people\-oriented HR professional who has worked in environments where the workforce includes skilled tradespeople. They understand that HR in manufacturing is different from HR in a corporate office — and they are energized by that.

We are looking for someone who is:

* A strong communicator across all levels of the organization.
* Fair, consistent, and trusted by both employees and management.
* Proactive — identifies HR issues before they become problems.
* Organized and able to build systems without over\-complicating them.
* Comfortable working in a hands\-on, fast\-moving production environment.
* Genuinely committed to building a great place to work.
* Capable of making difficult HR decisions when necessary.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

**Salary Range:** $65,000 – $75,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications

**401(k) Match:** 5% company match

**Bonus Potential:** Performance\-based, tied to hiring efficiency, retention, compliance, and HR program outcomes

**Benefits:** Health insurance, dental, vision, paid time off, and other company benefits

**Why Join Us**

This is an opportunity to build and own an HR function at a company that is growing quickly and taking the right steps to invest in its people. You will have real impact — not just execute someone else's HR playbook. The work you do here will directly shape the culture, retention, and capability of a company that builds boats for commercial operators, law enforcement, government agencies, and recreational customers across North America.

IMS is headquartered in Bremerton, WA — a community with strong ties to the maritime and defense industries. We are proud to build here, hire here, and grow here.

**How to Apply**

Submit your resume and a brief cover letter describing your HR experience — especially in manufacturing or trades environments — to:

**Info@InventechMarine.com**

*Subject line: HR Manager Application — \[Your Name]*

*Inventech Marine Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid jury duty
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

title: HR Payroll Administrator
description:
**Summary**
-----------

  

  

  

**Come make a difference and join team Metro!**

 **King County Metro Transit’s Employee Services Division** is seeking a detail\-oriented and equity\-driven **HR Payroll Administrator** to ensure accuracy, integrity, and compliance of payroll processes supporting over 6000 employees across a vast and diverse range of job classifications for one of North America's largest and most innovative transit agencies.


The HR Payroll Administrator is a new position where you will play a critical role in delivering timely, precise, and customer\-centered payroll services for a large, complex workforce. You will interpret and apply labor contracts, analyze payroll and timekeeping data, resolve discrepancies, coordinate leave programs, support system enhancements, and develop procedures and training that strengthen consistency and operational excellence across the organization.


This position offers a high level of responsibility, independence, and influence. Your work will directly impact employees’ experiences, operational efficiency, compliance practices, and Metro’s ongoing commitment to equity and social justice. By ensuring payroll processes are fair, transparent, and reliable, you will help sustain the foundation of trust that enables Metro Transit to deliver safe, equitable, and high\-quality service to our community.

  

This recruitment will be used to fill one (1\) Term\-Limited Temporary (TLT) or Special Duty Assignment (SDA) position expected to last through December 31, 2027, with the possibility of extension. Additionally, the selection process may be used to generate an eligibility pool for future Career Service, TLT, or SDA positions that may occur within this classification. The eligibility pool will be retained for 12 months from the date of posting and may be used at the discretion of the hiring authority. An additional HR Payroll Administrator position is anticipated in the near future.
The HR Payroll Administrator is an Administrator II classification.
**Job Duties**
--------------


Applying equity and social justice principles is a daily responsibility and foundational expectation for all King County employees. In this role, you will apply equity and social justice principles that exemplify shared values, behaviors, and practices to all aspects of this work. As the **HR Payroll Administrator**, you will actively integrate these values into all aspects of your work, including the following duties:

* Administer payroll operations in compliance with Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBAs), federal and state regulations, King County policies, and departmental procedures.
* Process, audit, and maintain payroll records in PeopleSoft, including adjustments, benefit accruals, step progressions, work schedules, union dues, combo codes, and time reporting codes (TRCs).
* Analyze payroll, timekeeping, leave, and financial data to identify discrepancies, ensure data integrity, resolve payroll issues, and maintain compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct audits of time reporting, overtime, leave usage, and personnel actions to ensure adherence with CBAs, payroll policies, and HR standards.
* Monitor payroll components of employee leave programs (FMLA, KCFML, PFML, Paid Parental Leave (PPL), On\-the\-Job Injury (OJI), and others), coordinate reimbursements, track leave balances, notify HR of exhausted leave entitlements, and support Affordable Care Act (ACA) compliance.
* Collaborate and coordinate with Metro Divisions, Employee Services workgroups, and others to resolve payroll discrepancies and issues, implement personnel actions, validate and audit data, run reports and ad hoc requests, and ensure accurate payroll processing.
* Research, interpret, and apply complex CBAs, payroll regulations, and organizational policies to provide guidance to employees, supervisors, and management on payroll, leave, timekeeping, and cost accounting matters.
* Develop, implement, and maintain payroll procedures, standard operating procedures (SOPs), desk manuals, training materials, frequently asked questions (FAQs), and documentation to improve consistency, knowledge sharing, and operational efficiency.
* Train, mentor, and onboard payroll staff and PeopleSoft users including providing technical guidance on payroll processes, time reporting, and system functionality.
* Actively participate and support continuous process improvement (LEAN) efforts.
* Design, develop, and maintain payroll monitoring, tracking, and reporting systems, including leave compliance, reimbursement tracking, and payroll performance metrics.
* Support payroll system enhancements by maintaining PeopleSoft configurations, developing queries, managing TRCs and combo codes, testing system upgrades, and validating configuration changes.
* Plan, coordinate, and implement payroll\-related projects, including Employee Self Time Entry implementation, new CBA provisions, process improvements, compliance reviews, and resolution of systemic payroll issues.
* Maintain payroll and personnel records in accordance with federal and state records retention requirements, including document organization, cataloging, inventory management, and Content Manager administration.
* Communicate proactively with Metro Divisions to obtain information, resolve data issues, and ensure payroll deadlines are consistently met.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Experience, Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills**
-------------------------------------------------


We are looking for candidates who meet the following **minimum qualifications**:

* Experience completing payroll processes, ensuring policy compliance, and applying regulatory requirements in a large scale complex payroll operation, public sector, and/or unionized environment.
* Experience interpreting and applying labor and collective bargaining agreements for employees across diverse job classifications.
* Working knowledge of Fair Standard Labor Act (FLSA) Law.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to identify issues, work with large datasets, troubleshoot and resolve data problems, and ensure accurate data entry and data integrity with meticulous attention to detail and sound judgment.
* Experience using enterprise systems such as PeopleSoft and Oracle EBS to maintain and analyze HR, payroll, and financial data.
* Technologically adept, with strong proficiency across the Microsoft Office Suite including intermediate\-level expertise in Microsoft Excel.
* Proven ability to manage a high\-volume workload, prioritize tasks, and meet established deadlines while collaborating effectively with colleagues across various work groups.
* Experience developing and improving administrative processes, documentation, and standard operating procedures.
* Experience training others, mentoring, or providing system/process support to end users.
* Proven ability to work both independently and as part of a team while demonstrating initiative, accountability, and attention to accuracy including in situations with incomplete information or operational ambiguity.
* Experience building and maintaining strong working relationships with various individuals and groups from diverse backgrounds and roles.
* Strong interpersonal skills, including maintaining confidentiality, navigating sensitive situations, and communicating with tact and diplomacy.
* Experience providing high\-quality customer\-focused service in a professional setting.


Highly competitive candidates will have the following **desired (but not required) qualifications**:

* Working knowledge of Metro Transit’s operations, policies, and procedures.
* Payroll processing experience in a Department of King County.
* Experience using PeopleSoft and Oracle EBS.
  


**Supplemental Information**
----------------------------


**Who may apply:** We are accepting applications from all qualified applicants including current King County employees and the general public.

 **Required Application Materials:**

 **The following application materials are required:*** An online King County application updated with accurate contact information and relevant work history going back at least 10 years (or more, if necessary) with all job duties clearly explained.
* Completed supplemental questions. Responses to supplemental questions must be supported and verifiable by information found within your application materials.
* A cover letter no longer than two (2\) pages articulating how your knowledge and experience aligns with the duties and qualifications of this specific position. Your cover letter should also summarize your experience completing payroll processes, ensuring policy compliance, and applying regulatory requirements\- including tax principles, wage and hour laws, labor laws, and state and county regulations and ordinances\- in a large scale complex payroll operation, public sector, and/or unionized environment.

  

**Selection Process:** Applications will be screened to determine whether candidates meet the minimum qualifications, as well as for completeness and competitiveness as it relates to this position. Applications submitted without the required application materials listed above may be deemed incomplete and be removed from consideration. Additional documents, such as resumes, will not be reviewed if submitted. Please ensure all relevant work, volunteer, or other applicable experience is included on your online King County application. The most competitive applicants may be invited to participate in skill testing, one or more interviews and/or other selection processes. Formal offers will be finalized after candidates have successfully completed any necessary pre\-employment processes, such as internal record reviews or reference checks.  

  

**Work Schedule:** The work performed in this role is typically Monday through Friday, 8\.00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., but may at times require work outside of normal business hours. This position is non\-exempt from the provisions of the Fair Labor Standards Act and is eligible for overtime pay, with prior supervisor approval.  

  

**Work Location:** This position follows a hybrid work schedule currently requiring a minimum of two (2\) days per week onsite at King Street Center (201 S. Jackson Street, Seattle), consistent with King County Metro's hybrid work policy. Remote workdays may be adjusted or increased based on operational or business needs. Employees will have access to shared workspaces at various King County facilities. Employees must reside in Washington state and within a reasonable distance of their assigned worksite to meet reporting requirements.  

  

**Safety Responsibility: Employees**  

* Responsible for understanding this policy and their role in safety
* Report all safety concerns
* Follow safety practices and procedures as necessary to maintain a safe work environment and in conformance with applicable regulations, policies, and training
* Report safety and security concerns and ideas to supervisors or anonymously through data collection system

  

**Classification / Union / Job Code / Grade:** Administrator II / Non\- Represented Z3 / 281301 / 56  

Are you ready to make a difference? Come join the team dedicated to serving one of the nation's best places to live, work and play.

 **Application Process**


If you are interested in pursuing this position and supporting King County’s vision for unified, equitable, and high\-performing government, please follow the application instructions carefully. Provide us with your work history as applicable, ensuring that you provide details that highlight your ability to fulfill the requirements for this position.


If you need this announcement in an alternate language or format, or you would like to request accommodation or assistance in the application or assessment process, please contact Sarah Ottele at sottele@kingcounty.gov.

King County serves residents with a relentless sense of urgency, delivering on commitments with transparency and accountability. As a unified team, we uphold high ethical and stewardship standards, embrace change, stay curious, and continuously improve. Across all interactions, we listen first, act quickly, and stay aligned as a team to earn and sustain public trust. **Job Description**

**The School of Medicine Dean’s Office of Academic Appointments and Compensation, Integrated Resources, Academic HR, has an outstanding opportunity for an Associate Director, Academic Hiring Experience, to join their team.**

**About this Opportunity**
==========================

Reporting to the Associate Dean for Academic and Medical Staff Affairs, the Associate Director, Academic Hiring Experience (Associate Director) serves as a strategic leader responsible for the delivery, oversight, and continuous advancement of academic hiring experience services across the SoM including the SoM academic departments who participate in the SoM Integrated Resources, Academic HR.


The Office of Academic Appointments and Compensation (AAC) supports 31 academic departments and Dean’s Office units. This position is a trusted advisor to and key liaison between SoM departments, central offices, and affiliate institutions. The Associate Director translates complex institutional, regulatory, and policy requirements into actionable guidance; resolves sensitive and ambiguous hiring matters; and ensures that candidate, department, and faculty experiences are consistent, compliant, timely, and aligned with UW values.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Team Leadership and Talent Management – 30%**
-----------------------------------------------

* Provide strategic direction and operational oversight for the Hiring Experience team delivering academic hiring and onboarding services across the School of Medicine.
* Cultivate team expertise in the complexities of clinical and biomedical department hiring, academic appointment types, chair and executive\-level hiring workflows, and School\-wide compliance requirements.
* Lead team meetings to share policy changes, operational updates, process improvements, and collaborative initiatives.
* Build and sustain a culture of excellence, adaptability, accountability, inclusion, and shared learning that advances the academic hiring experience.
* Establish clear expectations, service standards, performance goals, and accountability structures to ensure consistent, timely, high\-quality, and customer\-focused support for faculty and academic hires and departments.

**Strategic Academic Hiring Operations Oversight – 35%**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Direct the effective and compliant execution of academic hiring experience services across recruitment, selection support, offer development, appointment processing, onboarding, offboarding, and transition activities.
* Provide School\-wide strategy and oversight for hiring plans, RFA processes, and JRRs, ensuring alignment with institutional expectations, operational timelines, and department needs.
* Oversee chair and executive recruitment processes, creation and coordination of offer letters, remote work requests, onboarding and offboarding activities, post\-offer compliance, and visa coordination.

**Policy, Compliance, and Risk Management – 15%**
-------------------------------------------------

* Interpret and apply relevant academic personnel policies, procedures, collective bargaining agreements, University Faculty Code provisions, SoM guidelines, affiliate requirements, and regulatory mandates related to academic hiring and onboarding.
* Develop and implement SoM hiring procedures and policies, with input from SoM executive leadership when applicable.
* Ensure hiring experience processes adhere to applicable laws, regulations, institutional requirements, and School\-wide expectations.

**Strategic Partnership and Complex Issue Resolution – 10%**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex or sensitive matters related to academic recruitment, chair and executive recruitments, post\-offer compliance, visas, hiring plans, RFAs, JRRs, offer letters, remote work requests, onboarding, and offboarding.
* Partner strategically with department chairs, division heads, vice chairs, administrators, AAC leaders, AHR partners, Integrated Resources AHR team, OFA, OHCE, central offices, and affiliate institutions to design practical solutions to highly complex academic hiring matters.

**Process Improvement, Service Delivery, and Institutional Representation – 10%**

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives, develop and maintain standard operations procedures, monitor performance metrics and represent AAC and SoM in committees, workgroups, and project teams.

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Health Administration, Public Administration, or related field.

**HR Operating Model and Service Delivery Framework**

* Stay up to date on emerging digital HR trends and bring innovative solutions to clients.

**HR Operations, Shared Services \& Outsourcing**

* Advise clients on transforming HR operations through shared services, outsourcing, and integrating digital tools and automation.
* Help clients evaluate sourcing options, driving cost efficiency and quality.
* Design and implement HR operating models leveraging these components.

**Process Optimization \& Automation**

* Lead initiatives to streamline HR processes using automation, AI tools, and data analytics.
* Implement intelligent automation solutions to enhance process efficiency, scalability and accuracy.

**Project Management \& Delivery**

* End\-to\-end delivery of HR reinvention projects, ensuring timely, on\-budget, and high\-quality outcomes.
* Integrate new technologies like cloud\-based HR systems and AI platforms into existing HR ecosystems.

**Change Management \& Stakeholder Engagement**

* Guide change management efforts to ensure smooth transitions to new HR processes and technologies.
* Facilitate stakeholder engagement, ensuring alignment with key business leaders and fostering buy\-in and commitment at all levels of the organization.
* Empower clients with the knowledge and tools needed to activate, apply, and sustain transformation initiatives long\-term.

* Foster a culture of innovation and continuous learning within the HR Reinvention practice.

* Experience writing compelling proposals and presenting to senior leadership to win HR transformation engagements.

**Employee Experience \& Talent Management**

* Lead initiatives to enhance employee experience through personalization, engagement, and alignment with company culture.
* Use HR technology, process improvement methodologies, and data analytics to improve talent acquisition, performance management, and employee well\-being.
* Design talent management frameworks that integrate automation and AI to optimize workforce planning.

**HR Technology Evaluation \& Selection**

* Lead the evaluation and selection of HR technologies (e.g., HRIS, AI tools) that fit client needs, culture, and business goals.

**Generative AI \& Emerging Technologies**

* Articulate how organizations should leverage GenAI and other advanced technologies to improve the HR function.
* Stay up to date on emerging digital HR trends and bring innovative solutions to clients.

**HR Operations, Shared Services \& Outsourcing**

* Advise clients on transforming HR operations through shared services, outsourcing, and integrating digital tools and automation.
* Help clients evaluate sourcing options, driving cost efficiency and quality.
* Design and implement HR operating models leveraging these components.

**Process Optimization \& Automation**

* Lead initiatives to streamline HR processes using automation, AI tools, and data analytics.
* Implement intelligent automation solutions to enhance process efficiency, scalability and accuracy.

**Project Management \& Delivery**

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of HR reinvention projects, ensuring timely, on\-budget, and high\-quality outcomes.
* Manage cross\-functional teams to execute solutions across HR domains.
* Integrate new technologies like cloud\-based HR systems and AI platforms into existing HR ecosystems.

**Change Management \& Stakeholder Engagement**

* Guide change management efforts to ensure smooth transitions to new HR processes and technologies.
* Facilitate stakeholder engagement, ensuring alignment with key business leaders and fostering buy\-in and commitment at all levels of the organization.
* Empower clients with the knowledge and tools needed to activate, apply, and sustain transformation initiatives long\-term.

**Business Development \& Sales**

* Lead business development efforts by identifying and generating new HR reinvention opportunities, building on strong relationships with prospective clients.
* Write and present high\-quality client proposals, business cases, and RFP responses that clearly articulate the value of our HR reinvention capabilities, ensuring alignment with client needs and expectations.
* Support business growth by working closely with senior leadership on strategic business development initiatives, offerings, and cultivating a pipeline of potential opportunities.

**Practitioner Development, Thought Leadership, and Innovation**

* Develop and coach practitioners on the functional craft of HR Reinvention; support learning programs and training efforts to develop our people.
* Contribute to thought leadership on HR reinvention trends and emerging areas of interest.
* Represent Accenture at industry events and conferences to enhance visibility and reputation.
* Foster a culture of innovation and continuous learning within the HR Reinvention practice.
* Ability to travel is required.

  

**Here's what you need:**

* Minimum of 5 years’ experience in HR transformation, digital HR, or HR technology consulting, with at least 2 years in a managerial or leadership role.
* Minimum of 2 years leading HR reinvention programs, including operating model, process, technology, or service delivery transformation initiatives
* Minimum of 1 year of experience applying AI, GenAI, automation, or analytics tools to improve HR processes, employee experience, workforce planning, or talent outcomes.
* Minimum of 1 year of Insurance Industry experience

**Bonus Points if:**

**HR Technology Expertise:**

* In\-depth understanding of leading HR platforms (e.g., Workday, SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) and their role in transforming HR operations and the employee experience.
* Expertise in evaluating HRIS, talent management systems, and AI\-driven solutions.
* Experience managing vendor relationships and technology selection processes.

**HR Operating Model Design:**

* Strong understanding of HR operating models, including shared services, outsourcing, and service delivery optimization.
* Ability to design and optimize HR operating models that integrate digital tools to drive efficiency and business outcomes.

**Employee Experience Focus:**

* Proven experience enhancing employee engagement and well\-being through innovative HR strategies and digital solutions.
* Ability to design employee\-centric HR solutions that align with company culture and business objectives.

**Project Management \& Delivery:**

* Expertise in managing complex projects from strategy to execution, on time, within budget, and with quality.
* Familiar with Agile and Waterfall methodologies and project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project).

**Business Development \& Sales:**

* Skilled in leading business development leadership and building strong client relationships.
* Experience writing compelling proposals and presenting to senior leadership to win HR transformation engagements.

**Thought Leadership \& Innovation:**

* Contributions to industry thought leadership through writing, speaking engagements, and research.
* Active participation in industry events to stay current on HR transformation trends.

**Client Relationship \& Stakeholder Management:**

* Strong interpersonal skills for building trusted relationships with C\-suite executives and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to influence senior leadership on HR strategy and technology decisions.

**Consulting \& Strategic Thinking:**

* Ability to think strategically and develop innovative HR solutions that leverage digital technologies.

title: WDVA Human Resources Manager, Full-Time Permanent, Olympia Central Office
description:
**Description**
---------------

  

  

**Human Resource Manager**  

**Full Time, Permanent**  


We are excited to announce an opening for a Human Resource Manager that will be directly responsible for ensuring expert level consultation to agency executives, managers, and employees in the areas of performance management, disciplinary actions, reasonable accommodation, protected leave management, personnel appointment process, personnel and position file management, and HR system management.  

**Please note:**The standard schedule for this position is Monday through Friday, 8:00 am to 4:30 pm. Flexibility in schedule is possible depending on workload and business needs, as approved by the HR Director. This position’s primary work location is assigned to the WDVA Central Office in Olympia with a requirement of **at least two in\-office days**. This position also requires on\-site presence at all WDVA locations intermittently, based on business need. Hybrid telework options may be available, based on operational needs, as approved by the HR Director. Must be able to work in an office setting, sitting at a desk for an extended period. Work closely with detailed information for extended periods of time.  

At the Washington State Department of Veterans Affairs (WDVA), we are passionate about our mission of “Serving Those Who Served.” As a national leader in our advocacy for nearly 500,000 Veterans and their family members, we strive to connect them to earned benefits as well as innovative programs focused on their overall health and wellness. In addition, we provide critical community services through a variety of programs, and at our four State Veterans Homes located in Orting, Port Orchard, Spokane, and Walla Walla. These locations provide Medicare and Medicaid nursing home care to Veterans, including, in some instances, their spouses, widows, or Gold Star Families.  

  

The Human Resources Manager is independently responsible to evaluate, plan for and ensure optimum daily human resource operational support is provided to all areas of business to support employees contributing to the mission of “serving those who have served”.
**Duties**
----------


**Some of what you'll be doing includes:**  

* **Supervises, directs, mentors, and evaluates a team of HR Consultants. Establishes performance expectations (PDPs) and ensure team deliverables align with agency goals and civil service rules.**
* **Oversees the delivery of agency\-wide performance management strategies.**
* **Guides consultants as they advise supervisors on setting expectation, coaching, informal investigations, Just Cause documentation, and progressive discipline execution.**
* **Manages the team responsible for processing and tracking complex leave programs.**
* **Directly oversees the Reasonable Accommodation (RA) process under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and Washington Law Against Discrimination (WLAD).**
* **Manages the operational execution of personnel actions, including appointments, promotions, demotions, transfers, leave, pay changes and all other applicable personnel actions.**
* **Directs the process for seniority calculations, HRMS update and reporting to unions and employees.**
* **Facilitates the agency layoff process including position identification, vacancy searches, seniority date assessment, establishing options, and issuing statutory layoff notices.**
* **Enforces accuracy and security in the maintenance of official electronic and physical HR related files. Audits records to meet state public records and retention schedules.**
* **Oversees all transaction entries into the state’s Human Resource Management System (HRMS). Maintains clear agency standards for HRMS data entry and actions.**
* **Serves as the designated negotiator, under the direction of the HR Director, for all collective bargaining agreements (CBAs). Develops comprehensive labor relations strategies aligned with agency goals, operational needs, and executive leadership directives.**
* **Manages statutory "Demand to Bargain" timelines and notification processes resulting from proposed changes to agency policies, working conditions, or hours. Assesses union notices, prepares management responses, and facilitates the formal bargaining timeline.**
* **Directs and oversees the formal grievance process in strict compliance with CBA timelines and Washington Administrative Code (WAC) civil service rules.**
* **Serves as the HR liaison to the assigned Assistant Attorney General (AAG) and the agency's internal legal counsel during active or pending lawsuits, appeals, and administrative hearings.**
* **Directs the HR team’s response to complex public records requests under RCW 42\.56 (Washington Public Records Act) and WAC 44\-14\.**
* **And so much more!**

  

**\*It is highly recommended to request a full copy of the Position Description. It is available upon request\***
**Qualifications**
------------------


**Required Education, Experience, and Competencies:*** **Bachelor’s degree in human resources management, public administration or related field.** ***A combination of education and experience may be considered on a year\-for\-year basis. Experience must be relevant to the position.***
* **At least five (5\) of human resources experience, three years of which must include supervising staff.**
* **At least three (3\) years of Labor Relations Management experience.**

**Required Competencies:*** **The ability to take action to learn and grow.**
* **The ability to take action to meet the needs of others.**
* **Must be proficient with MS office suite.**
* **Must have the ability to manage and protect highly confidential employee and agency information.**

* **Strong interpersonal skills to partner with diverse stakeholders.**
**Preferred/Desired Education, Experience, and Competencies:**

* Professional human resources certification (e.g., SHRM\-CP, PHR, or comparable) is strongly preferred.

**Special Requirements/Conditions of Employment:**  

* Must be able to travel throughout the state to WDVA facilities.
* Must be able to pass a DSHS BCCU Background Check prior to beginning services and every two (2\) years in accordance with WDVA Policy 615\.000 Background Checks. Information from the background check will not necessarily preclude employment but will be considered in determining the applicant's suitability and competence to perform in the position.
* Must successfully complete, within mandated timeframes, employee orientation and all other mandatory, annual, in\-service, and other required training.
* Must become familiar and comply with all DVA policies and procedures and Collective Bargaining Agreements as applicable.
* Must sign the confidentiality statement for all employees.
* Positions requiring travel must have a valid unrestricted driver's license and must be insured if driving a privately owned vehicle on state business.
* Candidates who are offered a job with WDVA must possess work authorization which does not require sponsorship by the employer for a visa now or in the future.

**Supplemental Information**
----------------------------


**Check out this awesome video****here****to see what it is like to work for the WDVA!**

**Application Process:**


Top candidates will be contacted directly to interview for this position. Because the selection will be based on information provided by you, it is in your best interest to identify the knowledge, skills and abilities that address the mandatory and desirable qualifications described below.  

  

 **Please include the following documents with your application:**  

 1\. A letter of interest. ***Please note, a letter of interest is*** ***required*** ***in order to be considered. Candidates who do not submit a letter of interest will not be referred to the Hiring Manager for this role.***  

 2\. A current resume detailing applicable experience and education.  

  

Finalists will be asked to provide a list of at least three professional references with current telephone numbers.

**Other Information:**

* This position is non\-represented.

 **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Employer**


Here at YOUR Washington Department of Veterans Affairs our employees come from all walks of life. We strive to hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or Veteran status.


We believe in the importance of recognizing the value each of us contribute to the success of the mission of the agency. Having a diverse workforce is this agency’s greatest resource of strength and knowledge. It is through the combination of talents and abilities that we can pursue finding effective measures on how we can provide the best customer service. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone.


The State of Washington is an equal opportunity employer. Persons with a disability who need assistance in the application process or testing process, or those needing this announcement in an alternative format, may call (360\) 725\-2183\. TTY users should first call 711 to access the Washington Relay Service.


You are welcome to include the name and pronoun you would like to be referred to in your materials and we will honor this as you interact with our award\-winning diverse and inclusive organization.

***If you have any questions regarding this announcement, program, or the agency, please contact us at*** ***recruiters@dva.wa.gov******.***

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Join the Pack at Pet Food Experts!**


With a rich history spanning over 80 years, Pet Food Experts has evolved from a small family\-run business into the nation's leading pet specialty distributor, proudly serving over 10,000 pet retail locations nationwide.


At Pet Food Experts (PFX), we do more than distribute the best pet products—we fuel independent pet retailers with passion, expertise, and an unwavering commitment to community. And now, with unprecedented growth and an expanded national footprint, we’re stronger than ever, ready to serve more retailers, support more brands, and make an even bigger impact in the pet industry.

**Schedule:** Monday\-Friday, ***Onsite***

**What You'll Do:**


The Human Resources Manager will provide full\-cycle HR support to our Tacoma, WA distribution center, while also supporting our cross\-dock locations in Meridian, ID, and Clackamas, OR. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to leaders and employees across the region, helping drive engagement, performance, and operational excellence in alignment with PFX values.

* Lead HR practices that promote a high\-performance, employee\-oriented culture emphasizing accountability, engagement, and professional growth.
* Partner with site and regional leadership to implement HR strategies that align with operational and organizational objectives.
* Serve as the primary HR business partner for assigned distribution centers, advising management on employee relations, staffing, and leadership development.
* Conduct and oversee employee relations investigations, ensuring fair and timely resolution of workplace concerns.
* Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local employment laws (ADA, ACA, FMLA, FLSA, Title VII, OSHA, etc.).
* Manage the ADA interactive process, coordinate with the third\-party LOA provider, and oversee Workers’ Compensation cases.
* Partner with site leadership on performance management, including coaching, corrective action, and performance review processes.
* Lead or support talent reviews, succession planning, and development initiatives across assigned sites.
* Participate in employee engagement programs, recognition efforts, and follow\-up actions from engagement surveys and exit interviews.
* Collaborate with Talent Acquisition to drive recruiting efforts for key roles and ensure seamless onboarding for new employees.
* Maintain responsibility for HR operations, including payroll change forms, I\-9 management, and personnel file integrity.
* Partner with Regional HR leadership to standardize HR practices, processes, and communication across distribution centers.
* Analyze HR metrics, KPIs, and trends to recommend proactive solutions supporting business goals.
* Serve as a change agent to foster consistency, compliance, and alignment with PFX values and expectations.
* Travel up to 20\-25% to other PFX distribution centers to provide leadership presence, guidance, and training support.

**What We're Looking For:**

* Proven experience as an HR lead within a distribution or manufacturing environment.
* Comprehensive knowledge of HR best practices, employment law, and policy interpretation.
* Strong interpersonal, coaching, and facilitation skills with the ability to build trust across all levels of the organization.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to deliver clear, consistent, and professional messaging.
* Ability to balance strategic priorities with tactical HR execution in a fast\-paced, high\-volume setting.
* Strong business acumen and analytical skills; able to interpret data and guide decisions based on trends and metrics.
* Proven ability to exercise sound judgment, confidentiality, and discretion.
* Customer\-focused, approachable, and solution\-oriented style.
* Spanish\-speaking ability preferred, but not required.
* Dependability \- This is an on\-site position at the Tacoma, WA Distribution Center and requires dependable, dedicated and purposeful engagement.
* Bachelor’s degree required (Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred).

In this highly collaborative role, you'll manage complex cases, provide strategic guidance on accommodation programs, and help ensure a fair, inclusive, and compliant workplace. You'll partner closely with leaders, Employee Relations, People Business Partners, and external stakeholders to create effective solutions that support both employees and business objectives.


**Why This Role Matters**

At Columbia Bank, we believe that creating an inclusive workplace is essential to our success. As a Sr. Workplace Accommodations Specialist, you'll play a critical role in helping employees access the support they need to perform at their best while helping leaders navigate complex accommodation and leave\-related situations with confidence.


Your expertise will directly influence employee experience, operational effectiveness, and compliance across the organization. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact by balancing employee needs, legal requirements, and business priorities in a thoughtful and solutions\-oriented way.


**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the organization's subject matter expert on workplace accommodations, disability\-related matters, and applicable leave laws.
* Manage complex, sensitive, and high\-risk accommodation cases from intake through resolution.
* Partner with managers, People Business Partners, and Employee Relations to evaluate accommodation requests and identify effective workplace solutions.
* Lead the interactive process with employees and managers, providing education and guidance on rights, responsibilities, and available accommodations.
* Review and assess medical documentation to determine eligibility and identify reasonable accommodations.
* Communicate directly with healthcare providers, when appropriate, to obtain clarification and support informed decision\-making.
* Develop recommendations that balance employee needs, business requirements, and legal obligations.
* Support program effectiveness through reporting, process improvements, training, vendor collaboration, and ongoing policy enhancements.
* Deliver education and training to leaders and teams on accommodation practices and intersecting leave laws.
* Stay current on federal, state, and local employment laws and regulatory requirements impacting workplace accommodations.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Employees and leaders receive timely, knowledgeable, and compassionate support throughout the accommodation process.
* Complex cases are resolved effectively while maintaining compliance and minimizing organizational risk.
* Strong partnerships are established with HR, Employee Relations, business leaders, and external stakeholders.
* Accommodation and leave programs operate efficiently, consistently, and in alignment with evolving legal requirements.
* Training, reporting, and process improvement initiatives contribute to a positive employee experience and operational excellence.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* High School Diploma or GED.
* 6\-8 years of experience administering workplace accommodations, disability programs, leave management, or closely related HR functions.
* Expert knowledge of federal and state disability and leave laws, including the Americans with Disabilities Act Amendments Act (ADAAA) and the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA).

Kelley Create is seeking a detail\-oriented and technically strong Payroll Accountant to manage full\-cycle payroll operations for a multi\-state workforce. This role supports a dynamic compensation environment that includes hourly, salaried, commission, and draw\-based pay structures.


The Payroll Accountant will ensure strict compliance with federal, state, and local wage and hour laws, maintain accurate payroll records, and support audit and reporting requirements. description:

* Respond to complex HR inquiries and provide accurate, empathetic support in a timely and professional manner according to defined standards.
* Execute complex employee lifecycle transactions in Core HCM, Benefits Administration, Talent and Workforce Management modules, as well as supplier systems, ensuring accuracy and adherence to established standards and workflows.
* Prioritize and balance multiple workstreams; supports coordination of activities and deadlines across multiple HR service teams.

* Collaborate with HR service teams (e.g., Benefits, Compensation, Talent, WFM) to resolve employee inquiries and resolve cross\-workflow issues.

* Human Resources Business Partner at a growth\-oriented downstream energy company
* Reporting to the site Human Resources Manager, the Human Resources Business Partner supports the implementation of HR initiatives, partners with leaders and team members with day\-to\-day HR needs, and helps foster a workplace aligned with our mission of “Humbly Serving Communities”
  

**Key activities include:**

* Serve as first point of contact for managers and employees for all HR matters. Be able to handle confidential and sensitive information discreetly and professionally. Foster trusting relationships with co\-workers and cross\-functional work areas. Professional behaviors that mirror our Company values of Respect for Others, Integrity, Collaborative Innovation, and Heart. * Talent Management – Ensure fair, consistent and focused recruitment practices to attract and retain an engaged, diverse and high performing team. Oversee the onboarding/off\-boarding processes

* Leave administration – Administer employee paid and unpaid absences in accordance with Family and Medical Leave Act and Washington State’s Paid Family and Medical Leave. Engage in the interactive process for reasonable accommodations and administer return to work with or without restrictions
* Performance Management – Coach managers and employees on performance evaluation ratings, rating calibration, goal setting and goal review. * Conduct data analysis to report on HR metrics and KPIs for better organizational awareness. Facilitate and/or participate in cross\-functional groups to develop key HR initiatives to improve organizational performance
* Develop and maintain status of compliance of all federal, state and local laws, including Title VII of the Civil Rights Act, ADA, FMLA, ADEA, FLSA, and EEO. Additionally, ensure reporting and audit support to responsible agencies

* Workers Compensation Administration – Assist in the design and administration of workers’ compensation procedures and program. Responsible for claims monitoring and administration. Communicates with employees, managers, insurance carriers, and medical staff on claims management and return to work requirements
* Coach and advise stakeholders on company policies and procedures across the organization to best ensure compliance. Interpret policies and procedures, identify gaps and draft suggested updates
* Perform other duties as assigned

Note: This description is intended to give you a general overview of the position. Additional responsibilities and opportunities may be identified based on current business needs.

To comply with the regulations at this work location, successful applicants must be eligible to obtain a TWIC card (Transportation Worker Identification Credential). Please review eligibility criteria at https://www.tsa.gov/for\-industry/twic .


Additional qualifications include:


* A bachelor's degree in human resource management, business administration or related degree from accredited university preferred
* Minimum three (3\) years of broad HR generalist experience in an environment in a hands\-on service model required
  

Competency in the primary functional areas of responsibility required
* Thorough knowledge of federal, state and local laws governing human resource principles and practice required
  

Working knowledge of labor relations and union environments preferred
* Strong proficiency in MS Office applications (e.g. Word, Excel, Outlook, Power Point, etc.) required
* The ability to handle confidential and sensitive information discreetly and professionally required
* ATS, HRIS and payroll experience with SAP SuccessFactors or Dayforce is a plus
* Conflict resolution and strong interpersonal skills, insight into group dynamics, empathy, and diplomacy \& tact through difficult conversations necessary
* Proven ability to build strong working relationships with organizational leaders required
* Ability to be forward thinking and strategic with respect to HR processes and systems, creating a climate for change required
* Self\-directed, organized, flexible and able to prioritize work in a fast\-paced environment required
* Professional certification (PHR or SHRM\-CP) is strongly desirable
* This is an in\-office position in the Port of Tacoma and 100% on site with a 9/80 schedule
  

**About Us**

At Par Pacific, we own and operate market\-leading energy and infrastructure businesses in logistically complex markets. We have built a team of downstream industry veterans and subject matter experts to lead our organization with an entrepreneurial spirit and a collaborative, problem solving approach. We bring our diverse strengths and motivation to complex markets where we seek out diamonds in the rough. As a nimble, growing organization, we actively pursue new opportunities with corporate financing know\-how, respond to local market demands, and adapt to changing external environments.


**More Good Reasons to Work for Par Pacific**


**Unique Culture and RICH Values**

There is nothing ordinary about Par Pacific \- a niche player in the energy space. And there's certainly nothing ordinary about Par Pacific employees. We are driven, hardworking, entrepreneurial\-minded professionals who love to win. Our RICH values describe how we approach our work: Respect for Others, Integrity, Collaborative Innovation, and Heart. If that describes you, you'll fit right in.


**Location, Location, Location**

Because Par Pacific operates in some of the most beautiful places throughout the country, our employees get to make these places their home and enrich their lives. The refinery where you’ll work is in the Port of Tacoma, Washington nestled against Commencement Bay and the South Puget Sound with sweeping views of Mt. Rainier


**Opportunistic Growth Strategy**

At Par Pacific, we look for operations with strong fundamentals and great employees who can move a business forward. Our management team has deep experience in the energy industry, as well as in leading mergers, acquisitions, and integrations of newly acquired companies.


**Focused on the Future**

We are an energy company that has recognized the imperative and embraced the opportunity to begin the transition from fossil fuels. We are developing products that help reduce greenhouse gas emissions.


**Excellent Compensation and Benefits**

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a strong comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision insurance, a robust allotment of paid time off, a 401(k) with company match, retirement savings plans, educational reimbursement, and more. Full\-time employees (and their families) are offered medical (with prescription coverage), dental, vision, voluntary critical illness, accident, life/AD\&D insurance, Flexible Spending Account and Employee Assistance Program. Employees can purchase company stock at discounted prices through the Employee Stock Purchase Program.


**Hiring Range**

The hiring range for this position is $76,000 to $129,000 plus 10% discretionary bonus. The candidate selected will be placed according to his/her skills and qualifications.


**Our Headquarters**

Par Pacific Holdings, Inc., based in Houston, Texas, owns, manages and maintains interests in energy and infrastructure businesses. We are a growing energy company focused on renewable and conventional fuels in the Western United States. Par Pacific also owns 46% of Laramie Energy, LLC, a natural gas production company with operations and assets concentrated in Western Colorado. Our common stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the trading symbol "PARR".


**Our Refineries and Logistics Operations**

We own and operate refineries in Hawaii, Montana, Washington, and Wyoming, with total operating throughput capacity of over 219 Mbpd. Par Pacific owns and operates one of the largest energy networks in Hawaii with 94,000 bpd of operating refining capacity, a logistics system supplying the major islands of the state and 90 retail locations. Overtime eligible employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month, earn a monthly proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Overtime exempt employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month do not earn a monthly accrual of sick leave.   

  

Sick leave accruals for part\-time employees will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday.  

  

**Vacation (Annual Leave)**  

Full\-time employees accrue vacation leave at the rates specified in WAC 357\-31\-165(1\) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA). Full\-time employees who are in pay status for less than 80 nonovertime hours in a month do not earn a monthly accrual of vacation leave.  

  

Part\-time employees accrue vacation leave hours in accordance with WAC 357\-31\-165(1\) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA) on a pro rata basis. Vacation leave accrual will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment.  

  

Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday.  

  

As provided in WAC 357\-58\-175, an employer may authorize a lump\-sum accrual of vacation leave or accelerate the vacation leave accrual rate to support the recruitment and/or retention of a candidate or employee for a Washington Management Service position. Vacation leave accrual rates may only be accelerated using the rates established WAC 357\-31\-165\.   

  

**Note:** Most agencies follow the civil service rules covering leave and holidays for **exempt** employees even though there is no requirement for them to do so. However, agencies are required to adhere to the applicable RCWs pertaining holidays and leave.  

  

**Military Leave**  

Washington State supports members of the armed forces with 21 days paid military leave per year.  

  

**Bereavement Leave**   

Most employees whose family member or household member dies, or for loss of pregnancy, are entitled to five (5\) days of paid bereavement leave. In addition, the employer may approve other available leave types for the purpose of bereavement leave.  

  

**Additional Leave**  

Leave Sharing  

Parental Leave  

Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)  

Leave Without Pay  

  

Please visit the State HR Website for more detailed information regarding benefits.  

  

Updated 01\-07\-2026

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
Description:
**About Girl Scouts of Western Washington**


Girl Scouts of Western Washington is consistently and unapologetically committed to providing safe spaces for all girls\* to belong. We build Girl Scouts of courage, confidence, and character who make the world a better place. Founded in 1912, our organization has been committed to meeting the needs of our youth members for over a century. We uplift all Girl Scouts in a supportive environment where they can discover their strengths and rise to meet new challenges—whether they want to climb to the top of a tree or the top of their class, lace up their boots for a hike or advocate for climate justice, or make their very first best friends. Backed by trusted adult volunteers, mentors, and millions of alums, Girl Scouts lead the way as they find their voices and make changes that affect the issues most important to them. They are the future leaders paving the way toward a brighter tomorrow. To learn more, visit **www.girlscoutsww.org****.**  

  

Girl Scouts of Western Washington values diversity, equity, and inclusion and we foster a welcoming, inclusive work environment. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, national origin, gender, veteran status, sexual orientation (heterosexuality, homosexuality, bisexuality, and gender expression of identity), marital status, or the presence of any physical, sensory, or mental disability, or any other protected classification under applicable laws.  

  

* *Girl Scouts of Western Washington uses the term girl inclusively to speak to everyone who identifies with the Girl Scout experience, which includes cisgender girls, gender\-expansive youth, transgender youth, non\-binary youth, gender nonconforming youth, genderqueer youth, and any girl\-identifying human.*
**About the Position**


The **Human Resources Specialist** at Girl Scouts of Western Washington (GSWW) supports the employee experience through seasonal and year\-round recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, training, and workforce outreach initiatives. This position partners with hiring managers and the Vice President, Human Resources to support recruitment efforts and attract mission\-aligned employees. The Human Resources Specialist also develops relationships with community organizations, educational institutions, workforce development partners, and other external stakeholders to increase awareness of employment opportunities at GSWW. The Human Resources Specialist coordinates onboarding activities, develops and facilitates employee training programs, supports employee engagement and recognition initiatives, and contributes to Human Resources projects that foster a positive, inclusive, and values\-driven workplace culture. Through strong relationship\-building, communication, presentation, and customer service skills, this position helps create positive experiences for applicants and employees throughout the employee lifecycle.


This is a **regular, full\-time (40 hours per week), non\-exempt** role that requires residency in Washington State, with preference for those residing in our Council Region of Western Washington. Work may be conducted remotely, but successful candidates must be willing and able to travel throughout the Council Region and work from GSWW offices, community locations, and other worksites as needed or requested. The starting pay range for this position is $27\.69 to $31\.16 per hour.


Girl Scouts of Western Washington offers an excellent work environment, meaningful mission\-driven work and a competitive benefits package that includes employer\-paid options for medical, dental, life/AD\&D for employees. Additionally, access is available for our 403(b) retirement plan, as well as voluntary benefits that include vision insurance and flexible spending accounts. Our generous paid leave plan includes three weeks of vacation to start, sick leave, paid holidays, paid time off for personal development and volunteerism, AND nearly two weeks of paid leave for our winter break.


Requirements:
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

 **Recruitment and Workforce Outreach**

* Coordinates and executes seasonal and high\-volume camp recruitment activities, including outreach, sourcing, candidate engagement, hiring events, and onboarding support.
* Supports year\-round recruitment activities, including job postings, applicant communication, candidate screening, interview coordination, and other hiring\-related processes.
* Participates in interviews and partners with hiring managers throughout the selection process to provide Human Resources guidance, reinforce consistent and equitable hiring practices, and support a positive candidate experience.
* Develops and maintains relationships with community organizations, workforce development agencies, educational institutions, professional associations, and other external partners to increase awareness of employment opportunities at GSWW.
* Represents GSWW at career fairs, hiring events, networking opportunities, and community outreach activities.
* Supports recruitment marketing, outreach initiatives, and employment branding to promote GSWW as an employer of choice.

**Employee Onboarding and Retention**

* Coordinates onboarding activities to ensure new employees have the information, resources, and support needed for a successful transition into GSWW.
* Facilitates new hire orientation and onboarding sessions.
* Maintains onboarding materials, resources, and documentation.
* Partners with supervisors and cross\-functional teams to support a positive onboarding experience.
* Assists with employee retention initiatives and programs designed to support employee engagement and satisfaction.
* Supports offboarding processes, including exit interviews, surveys, and related administrative activities.

**Employee Training and Development**

* Develops and contributes to training materials, presentations, job aids, and other learning resources related to Human Resources programs, policies, procedures, and organizational initiatives.
* Facilitates training programs, orientations, workshops, and presentations for employees, supervisors, volunteers, and other stakeholders as assigned.
* Supports implementation and administration of employee learning and development initiatives.
* Tracks training participation and maintains related records as appropriate.
* Assists in identifying training needs and opportunities to improve employee knowledge, engagement, and effectiveness.

**Employee Engagement and Culture**

* Supports employee engagement, recognition, wellness, and workplace culture initiatives.
* Assists with planning and coordinating employee events, activities, and programs.
* Supports employee feedback efforts, surveys, and engagement assessments.
* Partners with departments across the organization to promote employee engagement and organizational culture initiatives.
* Contributes to initiatives that support GSWW's commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, racial justice, and belonging.

**Human Resources Operations**

* Utilizes HRIS and other technology platforms to support Human Resources operations and reporting.
* Maintains accurate and confidential records and data related to assigned responsibilities.
* Responds to routine employee and applicant inquiries and provides excellent customer service.
* Assists with Human Resources projects and initiatives as assigned.
* Maintains confidentiality and exercises sound judgment in handling sensitive information.


This is a general description of the essential responsibilities of the position and is not inclusive of all job duties; other associated duties may be assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Knowledge of and commitment to fostering a work environment that prioritizes diversity, equity, inclusion, racial justice, and belonging.
* Strong alignment with Girl Scouts of Western Washington's mission and vision.
* Knowledge of Human Resources principles, practices, and employment processes.
* Strong relationship\-building and interpersonal skills with the ability to establish credibility and rapport with diverse audiences.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation, facilitation, and public speaking skills.
* Ability to develop training materials, presentations, job aids, and learning resources for adult learners.
* Ability to communicate information clearly and effectively to diverse audiences with varying levels of experience and knowledge.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong customer service orientation and commitment to creating positive employee and candidate experiences.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion when handling sensitive information.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Ability to learn and effectively utilize HRIS, applicant tracking systems, and other technology platforms.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**


This position has no supervisory responsibilities.
