description:
Why Planned Parenthood?
  
  

Working at Planned Parenthood Great Northwest, Hawai’i, Alaska, Indiana, Kentucky is more than a job. It provides the opportunity to contribute to our powerful mission and perform meaningful work.
  
  

In healthcare services, this means a commitment to providing the absolute best in patient care and education. Our exceptional health center staff drives our mission forward by upholding our acclaimed customer service \& confidentiality standards, and working to create a safe, judgement\-free space for anyone seeking Planned Parenthood services.
  
  

About our Talent Acquisition Specialist position
  
  

Under the direction of the Director of Talent Acquisition, the Talent Acquisition Specialist is a critical brand ambassador for PPGNHAIK’s mission and will support our mission by managing the end\-to\-end recruitment process for clinical and non\-clinical roles across PPGNHAIK. This position partners with the Director of Talent Acquisition, hiring managers, and HRE team members to attract, screen, hire and onboard qualified talent to support PPGNHAIK’s mission of providing high\-quality, compassionate reproductive healthcare and education.
  
What will you be doing!
  
The Talent Acquisition Specialist delivers positive candidate and hiring manager experience, ensures the recruitment process follows PPGNHAIK’s organizational policies and state/federal regulations, and supports PPGNHAIK’s commitment to cultivate and promote a culture that champions dignity, care, and respect.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Full Cycle Recruitment
  
* Managing the entire recruitment process from requisition intake through the offer acceptance and onboarding handoff.
* Conducting intake meetings with hiring managers to understand position requirements, competencies required, and hiring timeline.
* Collaborate with hiring manager to develop and/or revise job description; post position on internal and external platforms in alignment with PPGNHAIK brand strategy and applicable laws and regulations.
* Sourcing and attracting qualified candidates utilizing social media, community partnerships, passive outreach, job boards, employee referrals, and talent pipelines.
* Screening resumes and applications or minimum qualifications and preferred qualifications and conducting initial phone screening interviews in accordance with PPGNHAIK hiring process.
* Coordinating interviews with hiring managers; reviewing and preparing interview guidelines and evaluation tools needed, in collaboration with hiring managers.
* Facilitating the offer process, including compensation recommendations in partnership with the Human Resource Business Partner and Director of Talent Acquisition.
* Managing the pre\-employment screening process, including reference checks, criminal background checks, credential verification, and compliance and regulatory organizational requirements.
* Ensuring smooth candidate experience and transition into orientation process.


Hiring Manager Partnership
  
* Serving as a recruitment advisor to hiring managers, providing guidance on interviewing, selection, best practices and candidate management.
* Ensuring consistent communication with hiring managers regarding search progress, candidate pipelines, and candidate management.
* Partnering with the Director of Talent Acquisition to identify recruitment trends, workforce planning needs, and areas for recruitment process improvements.


Recruitment Compliance \& Documentation
  
* Ensuring all of the organization’s hiring practices comply with organizational policies, EEO, ADA, OFCCP, state and local labor laws and PPGNHAIK’s mission\-driven standards.
* Maintaining accurate recruitment data in the ATS and meeting all documentation and audit requirements.
* Following all confidentiality standards related to employee data, candidate information, and patient\-care regulations.


Employer Branding \& Candidate Experience
  
* Representing PPGNHAIK’s mission, values and culture in all recruitment interactions.
* Supporting recruitment marketing initiatives, including digital outreach.
* Ensuring candidates have a positive, timely, and informative experience at all recruitment stages.


Talent Acquisition Strategy Support
  
* Identify opportunities for pipeline development, especially for hard to fill roles.
* Providing feedback and data to support TA strategies, hiring forecasts and workforce planning.
* Assisting in developing standardized recruitment tools, templates, and interview practices.


**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* Minimum of 4 years of full cycle recruiting experience, preferably in healthcare or mission\-driven settings.
* Experience sourcing and interviewing candidates across multiple job families.
* Strong understanding of hiring compliance and best practices.
* Ability to manage multiple requisitions with competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Commitment to PPGNHAIK’s mission, values, inclusivity and patient\-centered care.


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience recruiting in multi\-state or unionized environments.
* Knowledge of reproductive care roles and competencies.
* Experience with ATS platforms (Dayforce, or similar)


**Salary Range:**  

**Washington:** $32\.25 \- $53\.75
  
**Alaska:** $30\.64 \- $51\.08
  
**Hawaii:** $29\.02 \- $48\.37
  
**Idaho/Indiana/Kentucky:** $27\.41 \- $45\.68
  
* Actual starting pay will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, education, internal equity, geographic location, and the budgeted hiring range established for the position.


**Position Type:**  

Remote position within our 6 states. Full\- time \- non\-exempt
  
  

**Benefits Eligibility:**  

This position is eligible for PPGNHAIK benefits. As part of our total compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits plan including medical, dental and vision plans, retirement, paid time off, short and long\-term disability and life insurance. For additional information about our benefits program, please send an email to hre.contacts@ppgnhaik.org.
  
  

**Other Information:**  

All new hires are strongly recommended to have the COVID\-19 vaccination, including boosters. All new hires hired between September and April must present proof of receiving a current flu shot.
  
What we expect from you.
  
* That you adhere to our code of conduct, policies, procedures, and protocols.
* That you always demonstrate a high degree of professionalism.
* That you always support and model our customer service standards.
* That you value continuous learning and seek ongoing training and development.


**Our commitment to diversity:**  

At PPGNHAIK, we’ve outlined our priorities and goals as we continue to cultivate and promote a diverse, equitable, \& inclusive culture that champions dignity, care, and respect, and where employees feel welcomed and motivated to do their best. These priorities reflect our promise to support programs and initiatives that promote continuous learning and organizational development and discussions on DEI topics; provide internal developmental opportunities; and assess what more we can do to nurture a supportive and equitable work environment.

Equal Opportunity will be provided to all employees and applicants for employment on the basis of their ability and competence without unlawful discrimination on the basis of their race, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, protected veteran status, marital status, age, disability, or any other status protected by applicable state or federal law.

title: HR Manager, Total Rewards
description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**


The Sr. HR Manager, Total Rewards is responsible for leading the strategy, design, administration, governance, compliance, and continuous improvement of BNBuilders’ Total Rewards programs. This role has company\-wide responsibility for **401(k), ESOP, compensation, and Total Rewards compliance**, including oversight of related program administration, data integrity, regulatory requirements, audits, reporting, collaborating with various departments.

  

The Total Rewards Manager directly manages the **Benefits Specialist** and works closely with the **Workers’ Compensation \& Leave Manager as a peer partner**. The two managers collaborate on leaves of absence and disability\-related matters where benefits, pay, workers’ compensation, accommodations, and return\-to\-work programs intersect, while maintaining clear ownership of their respective functions.

  

SALARY RANGE: $115,000 \- $125,000

  

BENEFITS:

* Group medical, vision, and dental insurance, including a choice of two benefit plans \- a PPO plan and a High Deductible/ Health Savings Account plan with company contribution to HSA.
* Company\-paid short and long\-term disability plans, group life insurance, and AD\&D plans.
* Untracked/unmeasured vacation.
* Sick leave accrued at 1 hour of sick leave for every 30 hours worked with an annual carryover of 80 hours.
* 9 paid holidays each year.
* Paid parental leave.
* Annual discretionary bonus based on company profitability and your manager's assessment of your performance.
* A 401(k) savings plan under which BNB matches the first 3 percent of your deferral with a 100% match and the next two percent with a 50% match for a total matching contribution of 4% of your pay. You are immediately 100% vested in all contributions (including BNB match). We provide both traditional (pre\-tax) and Roth (post\-tax) contribution options.
* We are proud to be an employee\-owned company. This means you get an ownership stake in BNB through a benefit called an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). It's 100% company\-funded and is invested in BNBuilders stock. You can participate in this long\-term plan after you complete 1 year of service (with at least 1,000 hours).

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead BNBuilders’ Total Rewards strategy and programs, with primary responsibility for compensation, 401(k), ESOP, benefits, and Total Rewards compliance, ensuring programs are competitive, compliant, financially responsible, and aligned with the needs of a growing construction organization.
* Lead the company’s compensation strategy and administration by overseeing the compensation specialist which would include reviewing compensation structures for field and non\-field, market benchmarking and salary surveys; job evaluation and classification; salary ranges; annual compensation planning; pay equity; and compliance with applicable wage, FLSA, pay transparency, and collective bargaining requirements. This builds on the existing construction\-specific compensation scope.

**GENERAL SUMMARY**  

The Human Resources Specialist performs specialized technical functions requiring a high level of specialized knowledge, accuracy, and attention to detail to support district personnel operations. Responsibilities include maintaining employee records and data, processing employment transactions, supporting Human Resources systems, supporting district compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies, and procedures, and providing technical assistance and customer service to employees, applicants, and administrators.  

  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**  

The Human Resources Specialist may perform all or a combination of the following:
1\. Audit, enter, update, track, and maintain employee demographics and information in Skyward, including contract and distribution lines, assignments, experience, benefit information, and other key data.
2\. Process new employee documentation, including Form I\-9, identification verification, Washington State Sexual Misconduct Disclosure Release forms, Social Security verification, and other required employment documentation. Schedule pre\-employment physicals and coordinate other pre\-employment requirements, as applicable.
3\. Evaluate educational documents, credentials, and prior experience to determine employment eligibility, appropriate hiring and placement, and compliance with federal and state reporting and audit requirements.
4\. Provide support and training to users of Human Resources information systems and electronic personnel records. Respond to a variety of inquiries, troubleshoot system and data issues, provide technical advice, train new users, and oversee and assist users of systems to verify accuracy to ensure compliance with all district, state, and/or federal guidelines.
5\. Monitor and support employee certification, credentialing, and qualification requirements by tracking expiration dates, reviewing applicable qualification requirements, maintaining required documentation, and assisting with compliance processes.
6\. Assist with district reporting of certificated instructional staff assignments to comply with the Every Student Succeeds Act (ESSA).
7\. Evaluate and create documentation for personnel and regulatory compliance under the supervision of Human Resources administration.
8\. Continually audit and maintain personnel data in Skyward and other departmental information systems to ensure employee records are accurate and complete. Research discrepancies and coordinate corrections.
9\. Research and develop custom reports, queries, and data analyses to extract and organize information. Work directly with constituents to identify reporting needs and present information in a format that is accurate, understandable, and useful to the intended audience.
10\. Research, test, implement, and support Human Resource systems, software updates, and process improvements to improve efficiency, functionality, and data accuracy.
11\. Provide accurate and timely information and assistance regarding personnel inquiries from employees, administrators, applicants, and other constituents. Research questions and refer matters requiring interpretation or approval to the appropriate Human Resources administration.
12\. Attend meetings, training sessions, and conferences to maintain current knowledge of applicable rules, regulations, laws, technology, and procedures related to personnel records and assigned Human Resources functions.
13\. May serve as a primary or backup liaison with contractors and services used by the district or department, including technical services.
14\. Track, monitor, and process highly qualified requirements and credentials for paraeducators and ensure required documentation is on file.

Provide guidance to coaches, staff, and administrators regarding stipend requirements, eligibility, documentation, timelines, and related processes.**OTHER FUNCTIONS**
16\. Assist with and provide backup for Human Resources administration in presentations, training, and educational efforts to improve districtwide understanding of and compliance with personnel regulations, requirements, and procedures.

18\. Serve on district committees and/or departmental work teams. Model appropriate, cooperative, and professional behavior, including protecting confidential information consistent with district guidelines.
19\. May perform other related duties, as assigned, consistent with the scope and responsibilities of the position.

Reports to Human Resources Administration

Required to meet inflexible deadlines; work in an environment with frequent interruptions and changing priorities; maintain concentration while performing detailed work; exercise discretion with confidential information; and occasionally deal with distraught or frustrated individuals.  

  

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**  

Requires sustained visual concentration; frequent use of a computer and other office technology; prolonged periods of sitting; and occasional standing, walking, reaching, and lifting of office materials.  

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**  

**Education and Experience**  

Education, training, skills, and experience necessary to carry out the assignment.  

One year of experience maintaining computerized records systems and performing general office procedures.  

K\-12 public school Human Resources experience preferred.  

  

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**  

Ability to read, write, speak, and communicate effectively.

title: Corporate Human Resources & Accounting Business Partner
description:
**Position:** Corporate Human Resources \& Accounting Business Partner
**Company:** Columbia Safety Services, LLC
**Location:** Seattle, WA — in\-office during training, then hybrid with up to two days per week remote
**Reports To:** Controller
**Employment Type:** Full\-time, salaried, exempt
**Bargaining Unit Status:** Non\-union
**Incentive Eligibility:** Not commission or incentive eligible; see Compensation
**Travel:** Minimal — occasional travel to branch offices  


**About Columbia Safety Services**

Columbia Safety Services is the corporate support team for a growing group of fire and life safety businesses across the Pacific Northwest and Intermountain West:


* Columbia Fire, LLC — Seattle, WA
* Valley Fire Control, LLC — Albany and Newport, OR \+ Spokane, WA
* FFF Protection — Greater Boise, with an office in Nampa, ID

  



Our companies design, install, inspect, and service fire sprinkler systems, fire alarm systems, suppression systems, portable extinguishers, and the life safety equipment that protects people and property. Columbia Fire has served the Seattle market since 2005\. We are a multi\-state regional company growing both organically and through acquisition, and we are building efficient, scalable financial and people operations as we expand.  



Our core values guide how we operate: Customer First, Grit, Effective Communication, Own the Outcome, Take Pride in the Work, and Do the Right Thing.  


**Why This Role Exists**

We now run payroll, benefits, onboarding, and accounting for multiple companies across three states, and both functions sit with a small corporate team that is stretched thin. Certified payroll filings, 401(k) uploads, benefit enrollments, bank reconciliations, sales tax returns, and month\-end close all land on the same few desks.  



That does not hold as we keep acquiring companies. Every acquisition adds employees, a payroll register, a benefits population, a set of business licenses, and another general ledger to reconcile.  



This seat exists to take real ownership of both halves — the people side and the accounting side — so the corporate team can operate ahead of the business instead of catching up to it.  


**The Opportunity**
**This is a genuinely hybrid role, and we want to be direct about that.**

Roughly half of this job is human resources administration and roughly half is corporate accounting. You will be the person an employee comes to with a benefits question, and the person reconciling the bank in Acumatica.  



That combination is unusual, and it is deliberate. In a multi\-entity company our size the two functions touch constantly — payroll journal entries, benefit accruals, workers’ compensation audits, certified payroll. Someone who understands both does the work better than two people who each understand one.  



You will report to the Controller, work closely with the accounting team, and have real influence over how these processes get built as we scale.  


**Human Resources Responsibilities**


* Serve as the primary point of contact for employees on HR policies, procedures, and employment\-related questions
* Coordinate full\-cycle onboarding, including new hire paperwork, orientation, system setup, and benefits enrollment
* Manage 401(k) enrollments and weekly contribution uploads
* Coordinate offboarding, including exit interviews, final documentation, and system access removal
* Maintain employee personnel files and HRIS records with accuracy, completeness, and confidentiality
* Administer employee benefit programs — new enrollments, qualifying life events, annual open enrollment, and coordination with providers
* Provide backup support for payroll processing, reviewing employee changes, deductions, benefit elections, PTO balances, and payroll audits
* Assist with weekly certified payroll filings
* Coordinate the annual performance review process with managers and maintain documentation
* Support recruiting with job postings, applicant screening, interview scheduling, and candidate communication
* Maintain recruiting platforms and the Applicant Tracking System
* Track employee certifications, licenses, required training, and compliance deadlines across multiple states and jurisdictions
* Coordinate employee recognition, wellness, and engagement initiatives
* Help maintain HR policies and the employee handbook
* Support annual workers’ compensation audits and respond to auditors and regulatory agencies

  


**Corporate Accounting Responsibilities**


* Manage daily bank transaction matching and bank reconciliations in Acumatica
* Process and record daily cash receipts
* Prepare and file monthly and quarterly city and state sales tax returns
* Manage business license renewals and regulatory compliance
* Coordinate vehicle registrations, fleet records, and related compliance requirements
* Support the monthly financial close
* Prepare and post general ledger and payroll\-related journal entries
* Reconcile assigned balance sheet accounts and investigate reconciling items
* Support special accounting projects and process improvement work

  


**Systems \& Process Improvement**


* Serve as our internal subject matter expert for WorkForce Go, including HRIS, payroll, timekeeping, and applicant tracking
* Identify and implement improvements to HR and accounting workflows rather than absorbing their inefficiencies
* Use AI and automation tools where they genuinely reduce manual work, and document what you build so the improvement outlasts you
* Support HR and accounting systems work through acquisitions and integrations

**Who You Are**


* Detail\-oriented — payroll and reconciliations punish approximation
* Organized across two functions with competing deadlines
* Proactive — you flag a problem before it becomes a correction
* Discreet — you will hold confidential employee and financial information every day
* Approachable — employees have to feel comfortable bringing you a question
* Willing to engage conflict — you address issues directly and early
* Self\-directed — you manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision
* Aligned with our values: Customer First, Grit, Effective Communication, Own the Outcome, Take Pride in the Work, and Do the Right Thing

  


**Who Struggles Here**

An honest filter, because this seat asks for two skill sets:


* If you want to specialize in one function, this role will pull you in two directions every week
* If you need a fully documented process to follow, a good deal of this is yours to build
* If holding confidential information is difficult for you, this is the wrong seat
* If month\-end close landing on top of open enrollment would rattle you, know that it happens here
* If you would rather send an email than have the conversation, the HR half will be the harder one

  


**Minimum Qualifications**


* Five or more years of combined accounting and human resources experience
* Experience supporting payroll administration and HRIS systems
* Experience with general ledger work, journal entries, and account reconciliation
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, payroll software, and ERP systems
* Demonstrated ability to maintain strict confidentiality with employee and financial information
* Strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to build working relationships at every level of the organization
* Residence in the Greater Seattle area, or willingness to relocate before your start date
* Fluent in spoken and written English
* Ability to pass a background check and pre\-employment drug screen

  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, human resources, business administration, or a related field
* Acumatica experience
* WorkForce Go experience
* Certified payroll and prevailing wage filing experience
* Multi\-entity or multi\-state payroll and accounting experience
* Construction, field service, or project\-based industry experience
* Experience supporting acquisitions or system integrations
* SHRM\-CP, PHR, or a comparable human resources credential
* Experience at a small or mid\-sized company where you carried a broad range of responsibilities

  


**Compensation**


* Base salary: $90,000 – $110,000 annually, depending on experience and demonstrated capability
* Classification: full\-time, salaried, exempt
* This role is not commission or incentive eligible. Discretionary bonus consideration may apply based on company and individual performance; bonuses are not guaranteed.

  



The upper end of this range is for candidates who bring genuine depth in both accounting and human resources, along with multi\-entity or multi\-state experience.

**Why This Role Works**


* Real ownership across two functions instead of a narrow lane
* Direct access to the Controller and the executive team
* You build the processes rather than inherit finished ones
* Multi\-entity, multi\-state work that keeps expanding through acquisition
* Paid credentials and continuing education in both disciplines
* Backed by a multi\-state regional fire protection group focused on the long term

  


**Benefits**


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance through Regence BlueShield, Delta Dental of Washington, and VSP — available to employees scheduled 30 or more hours per week, effective the first of the month following or coinciding with your hire date
* The company pays approximately 90% of the employee premium on the HSA\-qualified medical plan, plus a substantial share of dependent premiums
* Health Savings Account with a $600 annual company contribution
* 401(k) with Safe Harbor employer match up to 3\.5%
* Paid time off starting at 10 days annually and increasing with length of service
* Eight paid holidays
* Company\-paid basic life and AD\&D insurance
* Employee Assistance Program, telehealth access, and optional pet insurance
* Paid training, certifications, and continuing education
* Company laptop and technology package
* Paid training, certifications, and continuing education, including HR credentials

  


**Schedule \& Work Environment**


* Full\-time, Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week, based in our Seattle office
* In\-office during the initial training period, then hybrid with up to two days per week remote
* Standard business hours, with additional hours around payroll cycles, month\-end close, and open enrollment
* Primarily office\-based with extended computer use and occasional light lifting of files and supplies
* Occasional travel to branch offices

  


**Apply**

If you are strong in both accounting and human resources, and you would rather build the process than work around it, we want to talk.  



Columbia Safety Services, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.  



Employment with Columbia Safety Services, LLC is at\-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice, consistent with applicable law.

* Significant experience in employee relations, ADA, and FMLA, along with solid understanding of HR principles, practices, and employment laws

title: Senior HRIS Analyst - Workday
description:
Job Description
Are you a Workday expert who enjoys optimizing HR technology, solving complex system challenges, and driving operational excellence? Join us as we open a world of possibilities.


We are currently seeking a **Senior HRIS Analyst** to join our dynamic and growing team!

**Full\-Time, Exempt Position —** $95,000 \- $120,000  

**Remote**  

**Growth \& Development Opportunities**

**Who we are:**
---------------


The Center for Social Dynamics (CSD) is an organization providing services to those with developmental delays, including autism, in California, Oregon, Washington, Hawaii, Arizona, and New Mexico.


CSD’s people and programs deliver personalized, professional, evidence\-based behavioral and developmental services to each participant and peace of mind to caregivers that their loved ones are in the right hands and receiving the best possible care.

**What is a Senior HRIS Analyst?**
----------------------------------


The Senior HRIS Analyst serves as the primary Workday subject matter expert and is responsible for the administration, configuration, optimization, and ongoing support of CSD's Workday Human Resources Information System (HRIS). This role partners with Human Resources, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, IT, and business leaders to enhance system functionality, improve business processes, maintain data integrity, and deliver meaningful workforce insights. The Senior HRIS Analyst also leads system enhancements, reporting, security administration, release management, and strategic HR technology initiatives that support organizational growth and operational excellence.

* **What your role is:**
----------------------
* ### **Serve as the primary administrator and subject matter expert for the Workday Human Resources Information System (HRIS), ensuring system performance, reliability, and alignment with business needs.**
* ### **Configure, maintain, and optimize Workday business processes, security roles, notifications, validations, calculated fields, and system settings.**
* ### **Evaluate, recommend, and implement system enhancements that improve operational efficiency, automation, and user experience.**
* ### **Manage Workday releases by performing impact analysis, coordinating testing, deploying updates, and communicating system changes to stakeholders.**
* ### **Design, develop, and maintain Workday reports, dashboards, scorecards, and calculated fields to support business operations and strategic decision\-making.**
* ### **Partner with Human Resources, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, IT, and organizational leadership to deliver workforce analytics, operational reporting, and system solutions.**
* ### **Monitor and audit HR data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and data governance standards.**
* ### **Analyze data trends, identify root causes of system or data issues, and implement corrective actions and process improvements.**
* ### **Administer Workday security roles, domains, and permissions while conducting periodic security audits and maintaining appropriate system access.**
* ### **Support and troubleshoot Workday integrations, Enterprise Interface Builders (EIBs), Core Connectors, and third\-party system interfaces.**
* ### **Coordinate with vendors, consultants, IT teams, and business partners to resolve complex technical issues and implement new functionality.**
* ### **Lead small to medium\-sized HRIS projects, support enterprise\-wide technology initiatives, and participate in Workday implementation, optimization, and expansion efforts.**
* ### **Develop and maintain system documentation, configuration guides, standard operating procedures, and training materials.**
* ### **Provide guidance and mentorship to HRIS team members while serving as a trusted resource for Workday best practices and HR technology initiatives.**
* ### **Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.**

**What's required from you?**
-----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Human Resources, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Minimum of four years of Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS) experience.
* Minimum of two years of hands\-on Workday administration experience.
* Strong experience supporting Workday HCM and at least two additional modules such as Payroll, Benefits, Recruiting, Time Tracking, Absence, Compensation, or Learning.
* Experience developing advanced Workday reports, calculated fields, dashboards, and analytics.
* Experience configuring Workday business processes, security roles, domains, and permissions.
* Experience supporting Workday integrations, Enterprise Interface Builders (EIBs), Core Connectors, and Workday Studio preferred.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis and reporting.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and project management skills.
* Experience supporting multi\-state organizations and complex HR and payroll operations preferred.
* Experience leading Workday implementations, system optimizations, or major enhancement projects preferred.
* Workday Pro certifications are highly preferred.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non\-technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and data accuracy.

**Benefits \& Perks**
---------------------


You will have an opportunity to grow your career in this purpose\-filled industry where you can see results every day. Benefits include:

* Competitive, market pay based on experience, location, and skills
* Bonus eligibility
* Paid time off (PTO)
* 401(k)
* CSD\-issued devices
* Free college or tuition reimbursement through our Dreams Come True program

description:
***Collaborative people. Progressive builders.***


Consistently recognized as a best workplace, and for our commitment to safety, sustainability, and community partnerships, BNBuilders hires the very best in the construction industry and strives to create an environment that encourages innovation, responsibility, and client satisfaction. If you are looking to be a part of an open, supportive team and receive exciting challenges that promote personal and professional growth, look no further than BNBuilders!

 **JOB SUMMARY:**


The HR Compensation Specialist is responsible for supporting the administration of a competitive and equitable compensation program that align with the company’s strategic objectives as well as complies with legal standards, maintaining compensation data integrity, assisting with market benchmarking, and ensuring accurate compensation\-related records within HRIS and payroll systems. This role partners closely with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, and Operations to support competitive, equitable, and compliant compensation practices across office, field, union, and executive positions.

 **SALARY RANGE:** $33\.65hr \- $40\.87hr, $70,000 \- $85,000 annually *(companywide)*

 **BENEFITS:**

* Group medical, vision and dental insurance including choice of two benefit plans – a PPO plan and a high deductible / Health Saving Account Plan with company contribution to HSA.
* Company\-paid Short\- \& Long\-Term Disability plans, group Life Insurance, and AD\&D plans
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA) plans (for health care and dependent care)
* Vacation accrued on a weekly basis at a full\-time annualized equivalent rate of 15 days (3 work weeks) per year.
* Sick Leave accrued at 1 hour of sick leave for every 30 hours worked with a carryover of 80 hours
* 10 paid Holidays each year
* Paid Parental Leave
* Annual Discretionary Bonus based on company profitability and your manager’s assessment of your performance.
* A 401(k) savings plan under which BNB matches the first three percent of your deferral with a 100% match and the next two percent with a 50% match for a total matching contribution of 4% of your pay. You are immediately 100% vested in all contributions (including BNB match). We provide both traditional (Pre\-Tax) and Roth (post –tax) contribution options in our 401(k) plan.
* We’re also proud to be an employee\-owned company. This means you get an ownership stake in BNB through a benefit called an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). It’s 100% company funded and is invested in BNBuilders stock. You can participate in this long\-term plan after you complete 1 year of service (with at least 1,000 hours).

 **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Compensation Administration**

* Maintain job classifications, pay structures, salary ranges, and compensation records within HRIS systems.
* Assist in conducting market pricing and salary benchmarking using industry survey data and compensation resources to ensure internal equity and external competitiveness.
* Support annual compensation planning activities, including merit increase cycles, promotions, transfers, and market adjustments.
* Prepare compensation analyses and reports for Sr. HR Manager, Total Rewards and leadership.
* Participate in job evaluation processes by gathering position information, reviewing job descriptions, and assisting with compensation recommendations.
* Maintain compensation documentation and ensure compliance with established compensation policies and procedures.
* Support the review and processing of pay rate changes, promotions, bonuses, and other compensation\-related transactions.

  

**Reporting and Analytics**

* Prepare and generate regular compensation reports, dashboards to show turnover and workforce metrics, salary analyses, and workforce planning data.
* Assist with pay equity reviews and compensation trend analysis.
* Provide compensation\-related data and reporting support for budgeting and workforce planning activities.
* Work with the Sr. HR Manager, Total Rewards to analyze compensation data and identify trends, anomalies, or opportunities for improvement.

 **Additional Responsibilities:**

* Participate in HR projects, process improvement initiatives, and system implementations.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee compensation information.
* Perform other related duties as assigned in support of business needs and the essential functions of the role.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's or Associate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related field preferred.
* Three to five years of compensation, HR, payroll, finance or related experience.
* Construction industry experience preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* MS Office, Excel including pivot tables and Vlookups.
* Experience with HRIS and payroll systems.
* Understanding of compensation principles, market pricing, and salary administration.
* Familiarity with wage\-and\-hour laws, FLSA requirements, and compensation compliance practices.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Duties involve moving materials weighing up to 10 pounds on a regular basis and up to 25 pounds on an occasional basis. Manual dexterity and coordination are required over 50% of the work period while operating equipment such as computer keyboard, mouse, calculator and similar machines.

**Hybrid\-Onsite Schedule \- this role will travel to sites to ensure HR coverage and support as needed.**

**Job Overview**


The HR Generalist coordinates assigned division(s) responsibilities in employee relations, training, performance management, onboarding, policy implementation, recruitment/employment, retention and compliance with company, state and federal laws, regulations and policies.

* Establishes strong relationship with operations team as an HR consultant and maintains constant communication with sites and managers
* Some travel may be required for this position

Experience supporting a unionized workforce.

title: Senior Communications Specialist, HR
description:
Responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to: providing marketing and/or communications support for Seattle Children's organization\-wide projects and initiatives, and providing communications consultation and support to leaders, clients and work teams for projects and initiatives that span multiple audiences and vehicles. May involve initiating, developing, coordinating, implementing and/or evaluating marketing and/or communication plans related to these projects and initiatives. Other responsibilities may include content development for channels including newsletters, blogs, presentations, key messages, etc.; assisting with production and distribution of internal and/or external publications/collateral; updating content on Seattle Children's intranet and/or external website; project management; message development for senior leaders; helping mentor and train teammates; and communication support during crisis situations. Roles in the following teams rotate 24/7 on\-call responsibilities with their teammates: Internal communications; Patient and Family Education and Communications; Public Engagement; and Research MarComm. Sr. communications specialists who are part of other teams may have infrequent on\-call responsibilities, as needed.

**Note: This is a hybrid position in Seattle, WA requiring 3 days on site per week.**

  



**Required Education and Experience**  

Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, journalism, public relations or closely related field. A minimum of five (5\) years experience in a marketing and/or communications role.  

  

**Required Credentials**
  

n/a.  

  

**Preferred**  

Experience working as a marketing/communications professional in a healthcare setting. Experience managing complex, multi\-faceted communication plans involving multiple stakeholders and audiences. Experience with crisis/reactive communication, including response and support. Experience writing for print and online channels (e.g., newsletters; flyers; brochures; websites; blogs; etc.). Experience with Associated Press style and adherence to editorial and graphic standards. Experience with photography and/or image editing software (e.g., PhotoShop). Experience with web content management systems/HTML. Experience developing messaging with an understanding of social determinants of health, etc Experience providing marketing and/or communications consultation and support to senior leaders. Experience writing for multiple audience types and health literacy levels.**Compensation Range**


$88,786\.00 \- $133,180\.00 per year**Salary Information**


This compensation range was calculated based on full\-time employment (2080 hours worked per calendar year). Offers are determined by multiple factors including equity, skills, experience, and expertise, and may vary within the range provided.

**Disclaimer for Out of State Applicants**


This compensation range is specific to Seattle, positions located outside of Seattle may be compensated differently depending on various factors**.**

Together, we deliver superior patient care, advance new discoveries and treatments through pediatric research, and serve as the pediatric and adolescent, academic medical center for Washington, Alaska, Montana and Idaho – the largest region of any children’s hospital in the country.  

  

U.S. News \& World Report consistently ranks Seattle Children’s among the nation’s best children’s hospitals. For more than a decade, Seattle Children’s has been nationally recognized in key specialty areas. We are honored to be one of the nation’s very best places to care for children and the top\-ranked pediatric hospital in Washington and the Pacific Northwest.


As a Magnet designated institution, we recognize the importance of hiring and developing great talent to provide best\-in\-class care to the patients and families we serve. Our organizational DNA takes form in our core values: Compassion, Excellence, Integrity, Collaboration, Equity and Innovation. Whether it’s delivering frontline care to our patients in a kind and caring manner, practicing the highest standards of quality and safety, or being relentlessly curious as we work towards eradicating childhood diseases, these values are the fabric of our culture and community. The future starts here.

description:
**HRIS and Operations Coordinator (0\.50 FTE)**




**Part\-Time \| non\-exempt \| Approximately 20 hours per week**




**About The Northwest School**


The Northwest School is an independent day and boarding school serving students in grades 6–12 on an urban campus in Seattle’s Capitol Hill neighborhood. As Seattle’s only day and boarding school, Northwest offers a distinctive educational experience that combines rigorous academics with experiential, interdisciplinary learning in a vibrant city setting.




Our liberal arts program nurtures compassionate, globally aware, and environmentally conscious students who find joy in learning and are prepared to engage thoughtfully and creatively in an interconnected world. Northwest is a warm, inclusive community grounded in shared values and a deep commitment to belonging.


We believe diversity strengthens our school and are dedicated to building a faculty and student body that reflects the broader society. We strongly encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply.




**Position Summary**


The HRIS and Operations Coordinator provides administrative and transactional support to the Human Resources Department. Reporting to the Director of Human Resources, this position serves as the department's primary HRIS administrator and is responsible for processing employee transactions, maintaining HR data integrity, supporting payroll and benefits administration, and ensuring the accurate administration of employee information in Paycom. This role plays a critical part in ensuring employees receive accurate pay, benefits, and HR support while maintaining the integrity of the school's HR data. Success in this role depends on exceptional attention to detail, strong technical aptitude, sound judgment, and the ability to manage a high volume of HR transactions with accuracy and confidentiality. This position works closely with employees across the school and plays an important role in delivering responsive, accurate, and service\-oriented HR support while maintaining the integrity of the school's HR systems and processes.




**Essential Responsibilities**

**HRIS (Paycom) Administration**

* Serve as the department's primary Paycom administrator for day\-to\-day transactions.
* Process employee hires, transfers, promotions, compensation changes, and separations.
* Maintain employee demographic, position, and organizational records.
* Assist with onboarding and offboarding workflows.
* Process electronic personnel actions and ensure data integrity.
* Generate routine and ad hoc HR reports.
* Assist with Paycom system testing and implementation of new features.
* Troubleshoot employee and manager Paycom questions.
* Monitor data accuracy and proactively identify discrepancies.
* Recommend opportunities to improve HR workflows, automate processes within Paycom, and increase operational efficiency.

**Employee Records \& HR Administration**

* Maintain personnel files in accordance with federal, state, and school record retention requirements.
* Process employment verification requests.
* Prepare employment letters and HR correspondence.
* Track required licenses, certifications, and required trainings.
* Prepare and process employment documents related to compensation and contract changes under the direction of the Director of Human Resources.
* Coordinate new hire paperwork and onboarding documentation.
* Conduct routine audits of employee and payroll data to ensure accuracy and identify discrepancies before payroll processing.

**Payroll \& Benefits Support**

* Assist with monthly payroll preparation and auditing.
* Review timekeeping records for completeness and accuracy.
* Support benefit enrollment and qualifying life event changes.
* Assist employees with routine benefit and Paycom questions.
* Coordinate benefits documentation with carriers and vendors.
* Prepare reports for payroll, benefits, and audits.
* Coordinate annual HR processes such as contract distribution, benefits open enrollment, annual required trainings, and personnel record updates.

**Talent Acquisition Support**

* Post job openings in Paycom.
* Monitor applicant workflow.
* Coordinate candidate communications.
* Prepare offer letters and hiring documents.
* Coordinate pre\-employment screening, background checks, reference checks, and new hire onboarding.

**Compliance \& Reporting**

* Assist with annual compliance reporting.
* Process documentation and maintain records related to workers' compensation claims and leave administration.
* Prepare reports for audits and regulatory requests.
* Support HR operational projects and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Customer Service**

* Serve as a first point of contact for routine HR questions.
* Monitor and respond to questions in shared HR email inbox. Elevate to Director of Human Resources as appropriate.
* Provide excellent customer service to faculty.
* Escalate complex employee relations matters to the Director of Human Resources.
* Maintain strict confidentiality regarding employee information.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated proficiency using an enterprise HRIS, including personnel actions, onboarding, reporting, payroll support, and workflow administration.
* Experience with HRIS workflows, document management, and reporting.
* Associate's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Two or more years of experience in HR operations, payroll, HRIS administration, or a closely related administrative role.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

The City has adopted an anonymous application process that prevents hiring managers from seeing personal identifiers, including candidates’ names, addresses, and other similar information. For that reason, you will not have the ability to attach any documents to your application, including a cover letter or resume. Please make sure to submit a complete, detailed, and updated job application.
  

  

**Communication from the City of Renton:**  

We primarily communicate via e\-mail during the application process. E\-mails from rentonwa.gov and/or governmentjobs.com should be placed on your safe domain list to ensure you receive notifications in a timely manner. As a precaution, you may also want to check your junk e\-mail folders. We also communicate via text and encourage you to sign up for text alerts when completing your job application.  

  

**Telework Program**  

The City of Renton supports workers performing in a hybrid capacity (partial telework/in\-office) where job responsibilities can be performed remotely. This position may be eligible for a telework arrangement, up to 2 days remote, based on the operational needs of the City and specific Department. Regardless of job title or telework arrangement, City of Renton employees must reside in Washington State and within a reasonable distance to their worksite to respond to workplace reporting requirements.  

**Accommodation**
Individuals needing accommodation in the application, testing, or interview process may contact ajamilova@rentonwa.gov at least 2 days prior to the need.

**Recruitment Process:**  

The screening process will include a review of minimum qualifications and applicants selected for an interview will be invited via email to self\-schedule a time through the Government Jobs account. At minimum, this position will be subject to a standard criminal background check and professional reference check. This position requires accessing areas that contain Criminal Justice Information Systems (CJIS). For that reason, this position is also subject to a national fingerprint\-based records check.
  
**This position is Non\-Represented and the applicable benefits are as follows:**  



**Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance*** Employees are offered a choice of medical/vision coverage through either Kaiser Permanente or the City's self\-insured plan. Preferred Provider Option is available through the self\-insured plan. Rates for both plans are available on the Benefit webpage. Please click on the link at the bottom of the page for details.
* The dental insurance plan covers services such as regular checkups, x\-rays, fillings and crowns. Orthodontia coverage is also provided.

**Deferred Compensation Program*** The City contributes **4%**of the employee's base wage rate into a deferred compensation retirement plan.
* Employees may also set aside a percentage of their earnings on a tax\-deferred basis.

**Retirement Plan*** Employees are enrolled in the State of Washington Department of Retirement Systems Plan (PERS).
* Both the employee and employer contribute to the plan.

**Life Insurance*** A group term life insurance policy is provided to each employee at a value equivalent to the annual salary, up to $50,000\.
* Each eligible dependent is also provided with a $1,000 policy. There is no cost to the employee.
* Optional supplemental insurance is available for employees and their dependents at group rates.

**Long Term Disability Protection*** Many employees are provided with a long term disability policy up to the equivalent of 60% of their salary.

**Flexible Benefits*** The City offers employees the opportunity to open two separate tax\-free accounts through salary reduction. One account is to pay for expenses not covered by health insurance and the other account is for child care costs.

**Vacation*** Employees accrue vacation beginning with the first day of employment as follows: 12 days per year (0\-5 years); 18 days per year (6\-10 years); 21 days per year (11\-15 years); 24 days per year (16\-20 years); and 27 days per year (21\+ years).

**Sick Leave*** Upon employment, the employee receives a sick leave bank of 24 hours, with an additional 24 hours awarded after three months.
* Thereafter, sick leave accrues at the rate of four hours each pay period.

**Employee Assistance Program*** A confidential counseling assessment and referral service is available without cost to employees and family members for help with personal, family or job\-related problems.

**Paydays*** The City of Renton pays employees on the tenth and the twenty\-fifth of each month (24 pay periods each year).

**Holidays*** The City recognizes eleven holidays and offers two "personal" holidays each calendar year for most employees.

**Hours of Work*** Flexible work schedules are available in many departments.

**Transportation*** Unlimited free rides on various bus systems as well as various carpool and rideshare options are available for City employees.

**Management Leave*** All non\-represented employees that are non\-overtime eligible shall be given a management leave bank of non\-accruable leave in the following amounts: 56 hours for Administrators, Deputy Administrators, Directors, and the City Clerk; 40 hours for Managers, Analysts, and Others
* Non\-accruable management leave is to be used within the calendar year that it is credited to employee's leave bank.

* Administer accurate and timely multi\-company, multi\-state payrolls, ensuring compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

* Support internal and external audits and ensure compliance with payroll, wage and hour, tax, ACA, ERISA, HIPAA, COBRA, retirement, and other applicable regulations.

* Train HR staff, managers, and employees on payroll, HRIS, benefits, timekeeping, and learning systems.
* Manage relationships with ADP and other payroll, benefits and HRIS vendors.
* Lead payroll, HRIS, and benefits integration activities for newly acquired operating companies.
* Continuously improve payroll, benefits, and HRIS processes through automation, reporting enhancements, and strengthened internal controls.
* Maintain confidentiality of sensitive employee and organizational information.
* Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field preferred.
* Five or more years of progressively responsible experience administering multi\-state payroll, employee benefits, and HRIS systems.
* Advanced experience with ADP Workforce Now system administration.
* Experience leading HRIS implementations, payroll conversions, acquisitions, or system integrations preferred.
* Experience administering Learning Management Systems preferred.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; Power BI experience preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**

* Comprehensive knowledge of payroll administration, benefits administration, HRIS management, and employment compliance.
* Strong understanding of federal and state payroll tax laws, wage and hour regulations, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, ERISA, and retirement plan administration.
* Demonstrated ability to manage enterprise HR systems, lead implementations, and improve business processes.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, project management, and problem\-solving skills.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and confidentiality.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

 **Job Title:** HR Coordinator

 **Effective Date:** 9/2/2026

 **Reports to:** HR Manager

 **Pay Range:** $24\.04 \- $29\.22

 **Status:** Full Time Part Time Regular Temporary

 **FLSA:** Exempt Non\-Exempt

 **Job Summary:**


The HR Coordinator provides skilled administrative and coordination support to the Human Resources team across the employee lifecycle. This position supports onboarding, personnel file maintenance, employee record updates, benefits and employment verification processes, interview scheduling, ADP learning assignments, and timely employee communications. The role helps ensure HR processes are organized, accurate, confidential, and responsive so employees and managers receive high\-quality support aligned with Chief Seattle Club’s mission, values, and compliance responsibilities.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Coordinate new hire onboarding tasks, including initiating assigned ADP onboarding steps, sending onboarding date confirmations and directions, preparing welcome materials, and supporting completion of required new hire documentation.
* Process new hire and employee status paperwork, including Personnel Action Notices, new hire bonus payment requests, payroll notifications, and other HR forms requiring accurate routing, approval, submission, or follow\-up.
* Support employment eligibility and compliance processes by completing Section 2 of Form I\-9, submitting E\-Verify cases, maintaining related documentation, and escalating questions or discrepancies as appropriate.
* Maintain accurate personnel, financial, medical, and digital employee files by filing documents daily, bundling completed files, organizing hard copy records, and protecting confidential information.
* Coordinate employee access and onboarding logistics, including submitting IT new user requests, registering ORCA card users, preparing staff ID badges, and ensuring required materials are ready for orientation.
* Respond to routine employee inquiries regarding HR processes, policies, documentation, onboarding logistics, and benefits\-related steps, providing timely information and escalating complex matters to HR leadership.
* Support recruitment administration by screening resumes or application materials as assigned, scheduling interviews, coordinating candidate communications, checking references, and helping maintain applicant records.
* Administer assigned ADP learning management tasks, including assigning trainings, sending reminders, tracking completions, and preparing routine reports for HR leadership.
* Compile data, update employee records, prepare routine reports, and support HR team projects, safety\-related administrative tasks, and department communications as assigned.
 **Non\-Essential Job Functions:**

* Serve as administrative backup to other HR team members, including support with interview scheduling, employee activities, file organization, invoice approvals, reports, and other duties as situation requires or as assigned by supervisor.
* Support resident safety by responding appropriately to emergencies, reporting hazards or incidents promptly, and modeling safe practices in alignment with agency policies and trauma\-informed care principles. Completion of all safety\-related trainings. May be asked to participate in safety meetings and support OSHA reporting requirements.
* Other duties as assigned.
**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required****:**

**Education:** High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate degree or bachelor’s degree in business administration, human resources, or a related field preferred.

**Experience:** Typically, 1–3 years of administrative, human resources, office coordination, or related experience required. Experience supporting onboarding, document management, employee records, or recruitment coordination is preferred.

**Licenses/Certifications:** Human resources certification preferred, or ability to obtain an HR\-related certification within one year of hire.

**Technical Skills \& Competencies:** Proficiency with Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, printers, badge ID systems, and standard office equipment; experience with ADP or another HRIS strongly preferred; ability to learn new systems; ability to maintain accurate employee records and confidential documentation; working knowledge or ability to learn HR processes, benefits administration steps, employment eligibility documentation, E\-Verify, onboarding workflows, and applicable employment and workplace safety requirements.

**Soft Skills:** Strong written and verbal communication skills; excellent organization, attention to detail, follow\-through, and time management; ability to manage competing priorities and high\-volume onboarding or filing needs; discretion and sound judgment when handling sensitive employee information; professional collaboration with employees, candidates, vendors, and HR team members; patience, adaptability, and a service\-oriented approach.

**Preferred Qualifications****:**


Experience working in a mission\-driven nonprofit, Native organization, social services environment, or organization serving vulnerable communities is preferred. Prior experience with ADP, onboarding coordination, personnel file management, employee communications, recruitment support, benefits enrollment support, or training tracking is highly valued.

**Physical Requirements:**


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit at a desk and work on a computer for extended periods; use hands and fingers for typing, filing, and handling documents; communicate frequently in person, by phone, video, and email; see and read documents and digital records; move throughout office and program spaces; and maintain accurate files and records. The employee may occasionally lift or move materials weighing up to 25–40 pounds, such as onboarding supplies, file boxes, office materials, or event items.


Work is primarily performed in an office environment in downtown Seattle’s Pioneer Square neighborhood. Noise is generally minimal, though interruptions and competing priorities are common. The position requires daily interaction with HR team members, employees, candidates, and managers and requires professionalism, confidentiality, and timely follow\-through when responding to employee questions or coordinating HR processes.

  

Most positions at CSC are exposed to members of the community who have experienced or are experiencing trauma in various forms including but not limited to: domestic violence, sexual violence, homelessness, unemployment, financial hardship, etc. As a result, staff are at risk of secondary trauma. Employees are encouraged to seek external support and maintain self\-care when working indirectly or directly with clients. Mental health care referrals for employees is Available *Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**Benefits Summary:**

**Full\-time employee benefits package includes:**

* Medical, Dental, Vision, and an Employee Assistance Program
* Public Transportation (ORCA) pass
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Time Off and Holiday Pay
* Transparent Pay Schedule
* Internal Hiring and Encouraged Advancement

This job description is subject to change at any time at the sole discretion of the company and does not establish a contract for employment.*

description:
If you are looking for employment with a purpose where you can help improve the daily lives of the members of your community, then consider a career with Pioneer Human Services!  

We are currently looking for a ***Human Resource******s*** ***Business Partner*** ***(******HRBP******)***with a passion for human services. This is an exciting opportunity to be involved with an organization focused on racial justice, second opportunities, diversity, equity and inclusion. **WHO WE ARE** **\-** **Our Mission**  

We empower justice\-involved individuals to overcome adversity and reach their full potential.  

For over 60 years, we have proudly serviced our clients with professionalism and empathy. We are a nationally recognized non\-profit with 35\+ locations across Washington state that provided a chance for change to over 9,500 individuals in 2024\. **WHAT WE OFFER**
At Pioneer, our employees are important. That’s why we offer a Total Rewards package that includes compensation and benefits to support employees' health, security, and balance. **Compensation:**
New hires start between **$84,466**and **$112,621**based on experience, qualifications, skills, competencies, internal equity, and market factors. While the full pay range is listed for this position for pay transparency, individual compensation is determined by various factors and may vary within the posted range. **Benefits:**
Eligible after 30 days of full\-time employment (minimum of 30 hours/week):* Medical
* Flexible spending
* Dental
* Vision


Additional coverage after 60 days:* Life
* AD\&D
* Disability

**Other benefits**:* Dependent Daycare Flexible Spending
* Tuition assistance (100% for bachelor's, 50% for graduate programs)
* Retirement plan (3\.5% annual compensation contribution, plus 3\.5% match for 6% individual contribution)
* Employee recognition programs
* Public transportation discount
* Employee assistance program (EAP)

 **WHAT YOU'LL DO**
The HR Business Partner (HRBP) position is accountable for the execution and delivery of HR services to include but not limited to: employee relations, employee engagement, retention, legal compliance, training initiatives, change management, policy development and interpretation, and special projects in support of company initiatives. This position requires the initiative to understand the business/operations in order to develop and recommend integrated solutions as it pertains to employee relations, policies, procedures and guidelines. Provides sound guidance, advice and recommendations, including helping business partners think through a range of options. Ensuring the use of a customer\-centric lens while balancing the role of employee champion and change agent is critical to the success in this position. The HRBP maintains an effective level of business literacy about the business unit's financial position, its midrange plans, its culture and its competition. Ensures consideration is made for the downstream implications of decisions as they relate to pertinent employment law, our company policies, or our culture is expected. Communicating needs proactively with our HR department and business management, the HRBP seeks to develop integrated solutions. The position formulates partnerships across the HR function to deliver value\-added service to management and employees that reflects the business objectives of the holistic organization.**PRIMARY/ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:*** Conduct regular weekly or bi\-weekly meetings to build positive employee outcomes by establishing and maintaining connections with leader/business units. Helps shape a positive work environment by staying abreast of current trends and anticipating impending employee concerns or needs.
* Delivers a consultative approach to employee relations, performance management, talent management and change management up to the middle management level.
* Provides human resource advice, support, consultation and guidance, including application of HR policies and processes, with leaders and employees. Navigates and recommends resolutions on employee issues, leads employee relations initiatives to ensure a positive and fair work environment, while maintaining compliance with local, state and federal regulations.
* Coache and develop leaders and managers to deliver people management capabilities.
* Analyzes trends and metrics in partnership with other HR functions to develop solutions, programs and policies.
* Manages and resolves complex employee relations issues. Conducts effective, thorough and objective investigations.
* Maintains in\-depth knowledge of legal requirements related to day\-to\-day management of employees to reduce legal risks and ensure regulatory compliance. Partners with the legal counsel as needed/required.
* Works closely with management and employees to improve work relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention.
* Provides HR policy guidance and interpretation.
* Develops job description content and ensures consistency in language, knowledge, skills, and abilities.
* Develops contract terms for new hires, promotions and transfers.
* Provides coaching to Managers regarding communication and delivery of sensitive information to employees.
* Collaborates with other HRBPs to develop appropriate and similar solutions in similar circumstances.
* Provides guidance and input on business unit restructures, workforce planning and succession planning.
* Collaborates with other program partners to develop appropriate grant metrics, reports.
* Partners with community resources to build community brand and employee pipeline.
* Identifies training needs for business units and individual executive coaching needs.
* Participates in evaluation and monitoring of training programs to ensure success. Follows up to ensure training objectives are met.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**  

***REQUIRED**** Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources or related field. An equivalent combination of education and directly related work experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
* Minimum of 5 years' experience resolving complex employee relations issues.
* Working knowledge of multiple human resource disciplines, including compensation practices, organizational diagnosis, employee relations, diversity and inclusion, performance management and federal, state and local employment laws.
* A track record of delivering consultative approaches to employee relations, performance management, talent management and change management.
* SHRM Certified Professional (SHRM\-CP) or SHRM Senior Certified Professional (SHRM\-SCP) credential or ability to obtain certification within one year of employment.
* Must be willing to work a flexible schedule that includes shift coverage (early morning/late afternoon), weekends, and holidays; this is critical to support the needs of the business and is subject to change.

 **PREFERRED/DESIRABLE*** Master’s degree in Business or Human Resources

 **EEO**
Pioneer human services is an equal opportunity employer of minorities/women/individuals with disabilities/protected veterans and does not unlawfully discriminate under federal, state, or local laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. EEOC is the Law/EEO Policy Statement  

**Pioneer Human Services is a Drug\-Free Company**
Pioneer Human Services is a drug free company. This position has been deemed safety sensitive under RCW 49\.44\.240(3\) and is subject to both pre\-employment drug testing and drug testing during employment, to include testing for marijuana.

For over forty years, Beckwith \& Kuffel, Inc. (www.b\-k.com) has been synonym of innovation, hard work and reliability. With locations across Washington State (Seattle, Kennewick, Spokane, Vancouver) and Alaska, we are a manufacturer and Distributor of industrial products and services.

This role will be a great fit for someone looking for an opportunity to put their leadership, exceptional organizational skills, team building, and deep understanding of the Human Resources function on a meaningful growth path.
