title: Recruiter & HR Generalist (Seattle)
description:
**Recruiter & HR Generalist**

* *This is a full-time, hybrid role based in Seattle, with an expectation of working in our downtown Seattle office 1–2 days per week.*

**About Housing Connector**

Housing Connector is a tech-powered nonprofit working to make housing more accessible for people who face the greatest barriers to finding a home. We partner with property owners, community organizations, and local systems to reduce those barriers and create more pathways to stable housing.

We’re growing our reach, our team, and the ways we support communities across the country. With that growth comes the opportunity to build the people, systems, and practices that will help Housing Connector scale thoughtfully while staying connected to our mission and culture.

**About the Role**

**What You’ll Own**

Housing Connector is growing, and we’re building the People team we need to support what comes next. We’re looking for a Recruiter & HR Generalist who can help us continue to raise the bar on how we hire while strengthening the People processes and systems that support our employees and organization.

Recruiting will be a primary focus. You’ll lead full-cycle recruiting across the organization, partnering closely with hiring managers to understand what they truly need, shape thoughtful hiring strategies, evaluate talent, and drive searches from role definition through accepted offer. We’re looking for someone who brings perspective and judgment to the process, not simply someone who manages the steps. You’ll advise hiring managers, challenge assumptions when needed, and help us continue getting better at how we hire.

You’ll also play an important role in the day-to-day execution of HR operations and People programs across the employee lifecycle. This role blends thoughtful partnership with hands-on execution, from improving how we work to making sure the details get done well. As the organization grows, you’ll have meaningful opportunities to deepen your HR expertise, take on new challenges, and help shape how the People function evolves.

**Recruiting & Hiring**

* Own full-cycle recruiting from intake through accepted offer, managing the strategy, candidate pipeline, scheduling and coordination, communication, ATS activity, and follow-through needed to keep searches moving.
* Partner with hiring managers to define hiring needs, develop effective hiring strategies and interview processes, challenge assumptions, and guide sound hiring decisions.
* Source, assess, and engage candidates while creating strong, consistent candidate experience.
* Maintain accurate recruiting data and use pipeline and funnel insights to surface risks, inform decisions, and adjust strategy when needed.
* Keep hiring processes moving through proactive communication, strong follow-through, and clear accountability.

**HR Operations & People Programs**

* Own day-to-day HRIS administration and employee data changes, ensuring accurate and reliable People data.
* Coordinate onboarding and offboarding, bringing together hiring managers, IT, People, Accounting, and other partners to create a smooth employee experience.
* Support benefits administration and open enrollment, respond to routine employee questions, and coordinate payroll-related employee changes with accounting.
* Coordinate recurring People programs, including performance management, employee surveys, training and development, and employee events.
* Build and maintain People reporting that helps us understand our workforce and make informed decisions.
* Support the planning and coordination of internal events, special projects, and other People initiatives as needs and priorities evolve.

**Help Us Work Better**

* Bring fresh perspective and ideas that help us improve how we recruit and support our people as we grow.
* Use data, technology, and AI thoughtfully to simplify processes, solve problems, and help us move faster.
* Spot opportunities and risks and bring forward recommendations rather than waiting for direction.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 3–5 years of experience in recruiting, HR, or a combination of both, with demonstrated experience owning full-cycle recruiting.
* Strong judgment and ownership. You move work forward, know when to make the call, and know when to escalate.
* The confidence to build credibility with hiring managers, offer a point of view, and respectfully push back when needed.
* Excellent communication, organization, prioritization, and follow-through across multiple competing priorities.
* Experience using an ATS and comfort working with HR systems, data, and reporting.
* Curiosity about the broader HR function and an interest in expanding your expertise and impact.

**Nice to Have**

* HR Generalist experience or exposure to benefits, payroll, performance management, learning and development, or other areas of the employee lifecycle.
* Experience with HRIS, particularly ADP.
* Experience using data, technology, or AI to improve recruiting or People processes.
* Experience working in a growing organization where processes and priorities continue to evolve.

**What We Offer**

Housing Connector offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employee well-being, equity, and professional growth, including:

* Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, vision plans. We pay 100% of our employees' premiums and 50% of their partners/dependents.
* Generous Paid Time Off: 22+ days PTO (in first year) and dedicated Community Service Leave.
* Extensive Holiday Schedule: Including a full week off in December.
* Paid Parental Leave: Supportive leave options for families.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Confidential resources for personal support.
* Life Insurance: Financial security for you and your loved ones.
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA, DCRA): Health and dependent care expense accounts.
* 401(k) with Employer Match (6%): Invest in your future.
* Professional Development Reimbursement: Annual reimbursement of up to $500 to enhance your skills.

*Housing Connector is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce and providing a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment based upon any legally protected status or protected characteristic, including but not limited to an individual's sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity, or pregnancy.*

description:
**Human Resources Generalist**  
Position Open Until Filled  
*First Review of Applicants Scheduled for November 2, 2026*

The ACLU of Washington (ACLU-WA) advances liberty and justice in the courts, in the legislatures, in the streets, and at the ballot box. Our work is rooted in the belief of a future where everyone in Washington, particularly those who have been historically and systematically denied full enjoyment of their promised civil rights and liberties, are free to do so without barriers. Defending and advancing these fundamental rights and core values requires exceptional staff. Learn more about the ACLU-WA.  
  
The Human Resources Generalist (HRG) will provide responsive day-to-day support to staff throughout the entire employee lifecycle, including addressing routine incoming employee inquiries, and supporting recruitment, hiring, onboarding and offboarding activities. In partnership with the Human Resources & Equity Director (HRED) and Human Resources Manager (HRM), the HRG provides reliable coverage across human resource functions to maintain departmental continuity and consistent human resources support across the organization.  
  
The HRG reports to the HRED in the Human Resources Department and is part of the People Services team. People Services works to support our staff with the understanding that advancing justice starts internally through the vendors we select, the policies we create, and the culture we build.  
  
**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Monitor the human resources mailbox and respond to routine inquiries in a timely manner while providing a high level of service to staff.
* Respond and support standard employee relations matters, proactively escalating issues requiring additional consultation, guidance and support to the HRED and/or HRM as appropriate.
* Maintain knowledge of ACLU-WA human resource policies and practices to support staff and help maintain continuity of day-to-day HR operations.
* Provide HR generalist support activities, related to the entire employee lifecycle and human resource functions as assigned to ensure continuity of HR operations during peak workloads, planned and unplanned absences, or as critical needs arise.
* Coordinate and facilitate recruitment and hiring activities including job postings, candidate communication, interview coordination, documentation retrieval and storage.
* Conduct human resources new hire orientation and onboarding activities, ensuring staff feel welcome and set up for success.
* Facilitate offboarding activities including staff communication, updates to employee records and final day collection of equipment and technology.
* Maintain human resource documentation (employee records, job descriptions, forms, HRIS data) in a confidential and secure manner following established process and procedures.
* Support training and development programing including scheduling, communications, preparation of materials, attendance tracking, training acknowledgements and other related activities as assigned.
* Aid in the creation of presentations, learning resources, job aids, communication materials, toolkits and other human resource training materials.
* Co-create and maintain scalable tools and resources related to the implementation of human resource initiatives.
* Contribute to departmental continuous improvement by proactively identifying opportunities for improvements to established process and procedures.
* Administer the organization’s learning management system (LMS), training records and related learning systems and technology to support consistent and compliant learning program delivery and tracking.
* Assist with the distribution of employee surveys, human resource data collection and reporting.
* Apply a consistent and reliable approach in day-to-day human resources work to support an equitable workplace.
* Handle a wide range of sensitive issues and confidential documents with discretion and good judgment.
* Adhere to recordkeeping, documentation, retention, and storage practices in alignment with organizational policies and legal requirements.
* Participate in and support human resource projects and initiatives as assigned.
* Sustain a current knowledge base of employment law and human resources best and next practices.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy when handling sensitive information, records, communication, and employee data.
* Perform other human resource related duties as assigned that are within the scope of the position.

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**

* A strong commitment to the mission, vision, values and goals of the ACLU-WA.
* Bachelor's Degree required with focus in Human Resources or business-related field a plus.
* A minimum of three (3) years of relevant and progressively responsible human resources experience in a generalist capacity.
* Experience supporting a wide range of stakeholders in a complex and dynamic work environment.
* Advanced project management, organization, and time management skills with the capacity to manage multiple priorities while maintaining appropriate levels of communication with an attention to detail.
* Strong interpersonal, written and oral communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and engage with employees across the organization with a wide range of needs and workstyles.
* Effective relationship building acumen with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
* Knowledgeable of federal, state, and local employment laws.
* Experience with Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS), learning management systems (LMS), Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn new systems.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain required levels of confidentiality for human resource matters and appropriately escalate sensitive or complex matters to appropriate HR or leadership team members.
* Demonstrated commitment to equity driven human resources practices.
* Successful completion of HR certification, i.e., PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP or SHRM-SCP is a plus.

**FUTURE WA ACLU'ers WILL**

* Be committed to advancing the mission, vision, and values of the ACLU-WA.
* Center and embed the principles of equity, inclusion and belonging in their work by demonstrating commitment to diversity with an approach that respects and values multiple perspectives.
* Be committed to work collaboratively and respectfully toward resolving obstacles and conflicts.

**LOCATION:** Seattle, Washington  
  
**CLASSIFICATION:** This job description provides a general but not comprehensive list of the essential responsibilities and qualifications required. The ACLU-WA reserves the right to change the content of this posting at any time without advance notice. This position is “non exempt” under the Fair Labor Standards Act and approved at (1) fulltime equivalent (FTE).  
  
**MENTAL DEMAND:** Decision-making, high emotional intelligence, giving and receiving feedback and building trusting relationships. The nature of this work can be emotionally demanding and requires thoughtful and clear communication and resilience.  
  
**WORK ENVIRONMENT & CONDITIONS:** The ACLU-WA observes a hybrid workstyle, with some staff working primarily remotely while others work in the office several days a week. The position requires maintaining some physical file records and word processing and is expected to observe an in-person hybrid workstyle. This position is required to work in the office a minimum of two (2) days per week.  
  
Our office is generally open between the hours of 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. and is located in downtown Seattle. The physical demands and work environment described below represent those required and encountered by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Input information into a computer for long periods of time.
* Access information communicated through a computer.
* Work some evenings, weekends, and holidays.
* Periodically work long and extended hours.
* Travel locally and regionally as needed.

**TOTAL COMPENSATION:** The ACLU-WA seeks to provide equitable and competitive compensation for attracting and retaining staff with the skill, judgment, and perseverance to confront challenges to civil rights and civil liberties. The hourly wage for this position is $48.35 to $59.34. A range indicates the intention to accommodate those with varying years of relevant experience, as determined by the salary scale.  
  
Starting pay is determined using our established salary scale, which places candidates within the range based on their years of direct and indirect relevant professional experience. During the hiring process, we review your resume to calculate qualifying experience using the same methodology for every candidate.  
  
**BENEFITS:** Generous benefits include three weeks of vacation, twenty-three sick days given in 2026, twelve paid holidays and two weeks of paid office closure. Employer-paid professional development, fully paid employee medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance, a retirement plan with employer contributions, student loan reimbursement, family care and adoption assistance, life insurance, and an ORCA card, the regional transportation pass.  
  
ACLU-WA provides laptops, home office supplies, certain equipment, and technology support. You will need an effective Wi-Fi connection and a way to communicate by phone. This position is eligible for a $150 stipend each month to help cover any additional costs while working from home.  
  
**APPLICATION PROCEDURE:** To apply, please submit a résumé and three references on our online job portal.  
  
**REFERENCES:** Please submit with your application three professional references who can provide feedback about and have direct knowledge of your work experience. Note that there may be outreach to other references that fall outside of your designated list. We will extend a conditional offer of employment before conducting reference checks.  
  
**HIRING TIMELINE:** This position is open until filled with the first review of candidates scheduled for November 2, 2026. We will schedule interviews with qualified candidates after the first review of candidates.  
  
**OUR COMMITMENT TO EQUITY, DIVERSITY, INCLUSION AND BELONGING**  
Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging (EDIB) are core values of the ACLU-WA and are foundational to our work to advance liberty, equality and justice for all. When we secure liberty, freedom and justice for those most marginalized, we ensure everyone experiences dignity and equity, enjoying freedoms unimpeded by racial, economic injustice and other forms of oppression. This work requires our collective commitment.  
  
With this in mind, we value a diverse workforce and an inclusive work culture. The ACLU-WA is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, disability, veteran status, socio-economic circumstance, record of arrest or conviction and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We do not conduct criminal background checks on our candidates.  
  
**PEOPLE WITH DISABILITIES**  
ACLU-WA is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance applying online, please email hiring@aclu-wa.org to receive additional information regarding how to request an accommodation for the application process. If you are selected for an interview, you will receive additional information regarding accommodations during the interview process.

**We Are:**

We are a global collective of reinventors applying the New every day to improve the way the world works and lives. New doesn’t mean being ahead of the curve; new is pushing forward the curve, riding the edge where the impossible meets the transformational and making it reality where it matters. Our expertise spans 40+ industries across 120+ countries and impacts millions of lives every day. We turn ideas into reality.

**You Are:**

You own the full process transformation design cycle for HR — from assessing how market forces, regulatory shifts, and technology changes are reshaping the function, through specifying the future-state process, to defining how people will adopt new ways of working. You’re the domain authority on your team: clients and colleagues come to you because of what you know about how HR actually works. You combine business expertise, technical literacy, and AI-enabled process design to drive transformation.

You are designing at the intersection of human, agent, and process as part of HR Reinvention transformation work. When you design a future-state HR process, you naturally consider how AI agent experiences should be shaped to serve both the business outcome and the people working alongside those agents. You also advise clients on how to create and capture value from AI and data — translating complex data into actionable insights and tying AI initiatives to measurable business outcomes.

**Role Overview**

For CHROs and Chief People Officers looking to deliver concrete business outcomes, HR Reinvention shifts the performance frontier of HR on two dimensions: supporting growth and productivity in the business, and transforming how the HR function operates. Drawing on proven platforms, deep technology ecosystems, and integrated services, we redesign HR to be faster, smarter, and built for a workforce that blends human capability with AI. The result is an HR function that spends less time on process and more time delivering superior business outcomes and innovating in employee experience.

As an Industry & Process Advisor Manager in HR Reinvention, you will help our clients pivot and lead them to reimagine the HR function. Your experience in the field makes you a leader that people look to for advice, while your people and storytelling skills mean you have no problem helping clients understand their choices.

**The Work**

As a Manager in HR Reinvention, you will lead future-state process and AI integration design for clients, embedding AI into both client deliverables and your team’s ways of working. Specific responsibilities include:

* Lead future-state HR process specification, AI integration design, operating model changes, and adoption planning for assigned HR functional areas
* Run client discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews; present and defend recommendations to senior HR and business leadership; manage day-to-day client relationships and issue resolution
* Drive benchmarking analysis and change-impact assessments grounded in deep knowledge of how HR functions operate across industries
* Facilitate design thinking sessions and co-creation workshops with cross-functional client teams to reimagine HR processes and employee experiences
* Connect HR operating model design to future-state processes, driving transformation approaches that are practical, credible, and aligned to business strategy
* Define and structure data and AI strategy within the HR function — assessing AI maturity, building the business case and investment roadmap, and shaping the technology platform blueprint and data strategy
* Embed AX Design principles into HR process specifications — defining how AI agent experiences should be shaped within each process step, including agent autonomy levels, escalation triggers, and human-agent handoff quality
* Infuse Responsible AI considerations into HR transformation vision and roadmap; identify people, processes, and technologies to develop and operationalize AI solutions in HR
* Maintain HR’s role in designing and delivering superior employee experiences through seamless, personalized, and insight-driven interactions across every HR touchpoint and the complete employee lifecycle
* Build and maintain documented redesign methods and playbook contributions for assigned HR functional process areas
* Contribute to business development by qualifying opportunities and co-authoring proposals; help define and implement new HR processes using tools like Workday, SuccessFactors, and Oracle Cloud
* Coach junior practitioners on HR process redesign methods, AI design principles, domain-specific trend assessment, and operating model design
* Travel varies by client needs and could be up to 80%

  

Basic Qualifications

* Minimum 5 years of experience in HR process excellence, process redesign, or management consulting with a focus on HR transformation
* Minimum 1 year of experience designing future-state HR processes with AI — including operating model changes, adoption approaches, and intelligent automation
* Minimum 1 year of experience integrating AI and automating HR business process design
* Minimum 1 year of deep expertise scoping and delivering project work in at least one HR domain (e.g., HR Process and Service Design, HR Operating Model Design, HR Organizational Design, HR Analytics, or AI-enabled HR delivery)

Preferred Qualifications

* MBA or Master’s degree
* AI & Data experience, including solutioning, designing, or delivering AI and data projects in an HR or enterprise context
* Experience using AI-assisted tools for benchmarking, analytics, or workshop facilitation
* Applied knowledge of AI Design principles — specifying AI agent experiences within HR process designs, including autonomy levels, escalation triggers, and human-agent handoff quality
* Strong program management and written and verbal communication skills; experience managing senior stakeholders
* End-to-end process design inclusive of people, agents, and digital systems
* Understanding of core HR processes (Talent Acquisitions, Onboarding, Workforce Data Admin, Leave Administration, Offboarding, etc.)

* Proven track record building benchmarking analyses and change-impact assessments within the HR function

* An HR professional who understands that helping companies redefine how work gets done — through AI strategy, intelligent automation, and process reinvention — is vital to business success. This role requires someone with the skills, the know-how, and the tools to help clients understand what the future of HR will look like and to make the change a reality
* Understands AI strategy, ecosystem choices, and how AI can transform HR business processes; proven track record using AI-enabled industry benchmarking analyses and change-impact assessments
* Familiarity with process mining or digital twin approaches for HR process validation
* Experience contributing to business development, proposals, or RFP responses; driven and entrepreneurial with ability to originate and shape new deals and lead go-to-market activities
* Helps define how teams work differently because of AI; leads teams of junior practitioners on effective use of AI tools and AI design principles in HR transformation contexts

* You know how to design and roll out projects using HR cloud-based workforce enablement tools like Workday, SuccessFactors, Oracle, and ServiceNow

title: Human Resources Associate
description:
**Purpose of the Job**
----------------------

Under general supervision, perform, plan and/or assist in Human Resource functions which includes coordinating support for all medical leaves including Family Medical Leave Act qualifying absences, Washington Paid Family Medical Leave, disability plans and Workers Compensation. Effectively coordinate all leaves/claims to include general administration, comprehensive leave management and program compliance with all federal and state leave and employment laws.

  
  
This position will be open until filled. The first review of applications will be two weeks from the opening date.

**Characteristic Duties and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------------------

Under general direction and guidance, serve as the liaison between employees and their departments for all medical leaves and workers’ compensation claims.

  
  

Interpret and administer leave programs and policies in accordance with applicable federal and state employment laws (FMLA, WPFML, Pregnancy Discrimination Act, etc.). Ensure that the workers’ compensation program is managed in accordance with applicable OSHA and workers’ compensation laws.

  
  

Administer all aspects of medical leave and workers’ compensation programs in a timely manner and in compliance with all applicable deadlines. Provide extensive leave management and coordinate all administrative aspects of medical leaves and claims. Conduct/coordinate investigations of all reported workers’ compensation claims.

  
  

Receive, coordinate, review, input and maintain the database for on-the-job injuries. Ensure investigative paperwork is completed by employees and supervisors. Coordinate and process Workers Compensation claims. Communicate with employees, health care providers and third-party administrators regarding L&I claims and light duty; facilitate in placing the injured worker in the light duty job and monitor the return-to-work process. Create and distribute the annual OSHA federal statistical reports. Monitor and update the agency bulletin boards to ensure compliance with legal requirements.

  
  

Provide substantiating documentation for the Department of Labor and Industries Stay At Work reimbursement program.

  
  

Independently approve and/or deny leave requests based on relevant medical information. Coordinate and organize all medical information and ensure that HIPAA and Employee Privacy guidelines are closely monitored and effectively executed. Ensure that all reportable workers’ compensation claims are submitted within 48 business hours from the date of the incident.

  
  

Manage all administrative aspects of leave and workers’ compensation claims to include tracking and ensure that paperwork submitted substantiates the need for leave.

  
  

Receives, reviews and processes short- and long-term disability claims; communicates with and coordinates claims processing with insurance companies; reviews and approves/denies employee applications for self-insured portion of long-term disability claims.

  
  

Work closely with departments to ensure that all relevant completed medical documentation is submitted for timely review. Maintain contact with employees on leave and coordinate all aspects of their return to work.

  
  

Work closely with supervisors and other department staff to identify, research and resolve leave-related issues. Partner closely with other Human Resources staff on all leave issues and workers’ compensation claims. Partner closely and contact other department staff regularly to review employees’ leave status and develop legally sound strategies for resolution.

  
  

Produce and manage reporting metrics and analytics for all leaves and workers’ compensation claims. Gather and analyze data for trend analysis and present reports as requested.

  
  

Manage vendor relationships (Association of Washington Cities, Kaiser Permanente Occupational Medicine, etc.). Ensure that Short-Term and Long-Term Disability claims are coordinated with FMLA, PFML or other medical leave programs.

  
  

Prepares and processes HR related invoices and paperwork for submittal to the Finance department.

  
  

Provide back-up support for correspondence with the Employment Security Department and Secure Access Washington.

  
  

Review and suggest modifications to the agency’s medical leave and workers’ compensation programs for greater efficiency, quicker return-to-work and lower claim costs.

  
  

Perform other Human Resources related duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications and Knowledge Skills and Other Characteristics**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Minimum Qualifications:**

Associate’s degree or equivalent in Human Resources, business administration or a closely related field and three (3) years of in-depth Human Resources experience with a focus on program management experience in Human Resources functions such as leave management, workers compensation, etc. or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  
  

**Knowledge, Skills and Other Characteristics:**

Knowledge of:

* Kitsap Transit operations, programs, policies and practices
* Principles, practices and policies of public personnel administration, including leave administration, Workers Compensation, OSHA etc.
* Relevant local, state and federal employment laws
* Current laws and legal issues in Human Resources

Skill in:

* Maintaining confidentiality and sensitive information

* Implementing, assessing and managing agency leave programs

* Presenting information clearly and effectively orally and in writing
* Working independently, addressing problems and tasks
* Performing work on various projects simultaneously under strict timelines
* Maintaining and evaluating records and preparing comprehensive reports
* Gathering relevant data, analyzing problems, evaluating and making appropriate recommendations
* Establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with employees and the public
* Understanding, interpreting, and explaining programs, regulations, procedures and guidelines
* Conducting insightful discussions
* Using personal computer and office software including word processing, spreadsheets and database programs in a Windows-based operating environment

* Problem solving, time management and prioritizing
* Empathizing with employees as they go through possibly life altering circumstances

Ability to:

* Analyze information and convert related activities into a comprehensive work plan
* Communicate and make recommendations to Supervisor
* Identify basic problems and procedural irregularities, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions
* Multi-task and drive multiple projects
* Work independently in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and tight deadlines
* Deal with confidential information

**Licenses/Certifications, Benefits, ADA and Other Requirements**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

Positions in this class typically require: dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard and other equipment, talking, hearing, seeing and repetitive motions.

Sedentary Work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. The Human Resources Manager is a hands-on HR leader responsible for the end-to-end employee lifecycle across assigned business units, programs, and locations throughout Pioneer Human Services. Initial areas of responsibility may include manufacturing, distribution, commercial kitchen/food service, behavioral health, reentry, housing, and diversion programs. The position is expected to flex across programs and locations without requiring modification of the job description.

The role partners closely with operational leaders and employees to translate business needs into practical people strategies and consistent HR practices. Responsibilities span workforce planning and staffing, onboarding and employee integration, employee relations and investigations, performance management, compensation support, engagement and retention, leave and accommodation coordination, policy interpretation, organizational change, compliance, and separation/off boarding. The Human Resources Manager develops a strong understanding of each operation, its workforce, staffing model, business priorities, regulatory environment, and culture in order to anticipate workforce needs, identify risk, and recommend solutions. The role balances employee advocacy with organizational needs and works across the Human Resources function to deliver an effective, consistent, and customer-focused employee experience.

* Provides HR leadership and support across assigned programs, business units, and locations and adapts coverage as organizational and operational needs evolve.
* Owns and coordinates the end-to-end employee lifecycle for assigned business units, from workforce planning and recruitment through onboarding, development, retention, employee movement, and separation/off boarding.
* Partners directly with leaders across assigned business units, programs, and locations to understand staffing, scheduling, productivity, safety, compliance, and employee-experience needs.
* Provides day-to-day HR leadership for a diverse workforce that may include hourly, salaried, shift-based, safety-sensitive, justice-involved, and regulated-program employees.
* Builds trusted partnerships with operational leaders through regular on-site engagement, proactive consultation, and an understanding of business objectives, workforce challenges, and operational priorities.
* Advises and coaches leaders on employee relations, attendance, workplace conduct, performance expectations, corrective action, and separations; ensures actions are timely, well documented, consistent, and aligned with policy and applicable law.
* Manages and resolves complex employee relations matters and conducts effective, thorough, and objective workplace investigations; recommends appropriate resolution based on facts, policy, past practice, organizational risk, and applicable requirements.
* Partners with Talent Acquisition and operational leaders on workforce planning, vacancy prioritization, candidate selection, hiring decisions, and onboarding to improve staffing stability and quality of hire.
* Oversees effective onboarding and employee integration, including coordination of employment documentation, required training, system access, site requirements, and role-specific compliance activities.
* Provides guidance on job descriptions, organizational structure, promotions, transfers, compensation considerations, and other employee changes in partnership with HR subject-matter experts.
* Partners with Benefits/Leave, Safety, Workers Compensation, Payroll/HRIS, Learning and Development, and other HR functions to resolve employee and operational needs and ensure coordinated service delivery.
* Uses workforce data and trends - including turnover, vacancies, attendance, employee relations, retention, and other people metrics - to identify risks, recommend interventions, and evaluate effectiveness.
* Provides guidance and leadership on restructures, workforce planning, succession planning, position changes, reductions in force, and other organizational transitions.
* Builds manager capability and reinforces leader accountability for employee communication, performance, engagement, scheduling, policy compliance, and workplace culture.
* Identifies training and development needs and partners with appropriate resources to strengthen leadership capability, employee performance, and retention.
* Maintains current knowledge of federal, state, and local employment requirements and applies sound judgment to reduce legal and organizational risk; partners with legal counsel as needed.Maintains regular on-site presence across assigned operations and flexes schedule, when necessary, to support employees and leaders across shifts and operating hours.
* Performs other duties and special projects as assigned in support of Human Resources and organizational priorities.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**  
***REQUIRED***

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources or related field. An equivalent combination of education and directly related Human Resources professional work experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressively responsible Human Resources experience, including significant experience managing complex employee relations, investigations, performance management, and advising operational leaders.
* Working knowledge of multiple Human Resources disciplines, including employee relations, compensation practices, performance management, workforce planning, organizational change, diversity and inclusion, and federal, state, and local employment laws.
* Demonstrated experience supporting operational, hourly, shift-based, or similarly complex workforces.
* SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, SPHR, or ability to obtain an HR certification within one year of employment.
* Ability to travel to assigned Pioneer locations and work a flexible schedule that may include early morning, late afternoon/evening, weekend, or holiday coverage based on business needs.

**PREFERRED/DESIRABLE**

* Master’s degree in Business or Human Resources
* Experience supporting manufacturing, distribution, food service/commercial kitchen, reentry, social services, healthcare, or other regulated operations.
* Prior experience leading HR projects, process improvements, or change initiatives across multiple sites or business units.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. **EEOC is the Law/EEO Policy Statement**

title: Staff Human Resources Manager - Department of Medicine
description:
**Job Description**

**The Department of Medicine has an outstanding opportunity for a full-time Staff Human Resources Manager within a shared-services human resources model.**

  

**About this Opportunity:**

Reporting to the Float AHR/HR Administrator, the Staff Human Resources Manager independently manages and oversees all aspects of staff HR operations for a portfolio of divisions within the Department of Medicine, which collectively represent large and complex organizations with faculty, fellows, and staff involved in clinical care, research, and teaching across multiple sites. Operating within a shared-services framework, this role has substantial responsibility for exercising discretion and independent judgment in effecting and executing staff personnel functions; such as, recruitment and hiring, employee relations, compensation, and staff development. The position balances standardization and efficiency with the need for divisional customization and responsiveness.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  
***Recruitment, Onboarding & Engagement (30%)***

* Deliver end-to-end recruitment services for a shared-services portfolio of divisions, including temporary and regular professional and classified staff, graduate students, and student assistants.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand objectives, assess hiring needs, create recruitment strategies, and manage searches through the recruitment life cycle.
* Provide standardized guidance on job description development, recruitment requests, and hiring processes, while accounting for divisional nuances.
* Consult with faculty to determine program management needs and supervisory reporting structure within their programs.
* Provide subject-matter expertise on UW hiring best practices, equity considerations, and compliance requirements.

* Manage onboarding and offboarding processes and associated Workday actions for supported divisions; advise on access to UW systems and conduct exit interviews.

* Educate managers on current policy and practice information for successful onboarding.

* Direct and manage staff performance evaluation process and ensure compliance with UW HR and Departmental processes.
* Guide managers on best practices in conducting performance evaluations.
* Facilitate and provide resources for employee professional development options.

Ensure divisional activities comply with departmental, School of Medicine, University, state, and federal regulations (FLSA, ADA, Washington State law).  



***Compensation Management (30%)***

* Review and recommend compensation for new hires and compensation changes across assigned divisions, ensuring internal equity and alignment with UW frameworks.

* Conduct salary analyses across the shared-services portfolio, the Department of Medicine, the School of Medicine, and the University.
* Advise managers on job description updates and oversee position review requests, ensuring consistency and equity across divisions.
* Educate managers on compensation actions, processes, and justification requirements.

* Oversee and initiate various Workday compensation actions (i.e. TPI/TSI, one-time payments, in-grades, etc.).
Review and process FTE requests in alignment with departmental standards.  

  

***Employee Relations & Workforce Support (25%)***

* Coach and advise managers and supervisors on organizational effectiveness, performance management, corrective action, and equitable employment practices; provide guidance on communicating difficult or sensitive information to employees.
* In partnership with Department of Medicine HR, oversee and coordinate layoffs and/or furloughs for review and approval by Campus HR.
* Serve as the primary HR liaison for assigned divisions, working closely with UW HR Employment (Employment Specialists and HR Consultants), Department of Medicine HR, and Campus HR Operations on a full spectrum of employee relations matters.
* Maintain professional working relationships with key campus partners, including the Office of the Attorney General, Disability Services Office, and the University Complaint Investigation and Resolution Office (UCIRO).
* Act as the division’s first point of contact for employee relations concerns; assess situations, interpret policy, and provide recommendations to divisional and departmental leadership regarding complaint resolution, conflict management, and corrective action.

* Manage leave and accommodation matters within the Division, ensuring compliance, and partner with Central HR Leave Specialists and the Department of Medicine on complex leaves.
* Counsel staff on effective use of paid and unpaid leave during extended absences, including FMLA and parental leave.
* Educate managers and employees on FMLA, paid leave, and institutional leave policies.
Partner with Division payroll specialist on Workday leave time management reporting for FMLA tracking, record keeping, and required communications for staff taking extended FMLA leave.  

***HR Development & Special Initiatives (15%)***

* Develop, implement, and maintain standardized HR processes, tools, and documentation that support shared-services delivery.
* Lead or contribute to departmental HR initiatives and strategic projects related to shared-services optimization.
* Participate regularly in professional activities to keep abreast of changes and new developments in Human Resources College and University Professional Associations (CUPA- HR) and Society for Human Resource Management (SHRM).
* Engage in continuous process improvement to identify and implement efficiencies and develop resources for staff HR team
Additional duties as assigned.  

  

**Required Qualifications:**  
To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Administrative Management or a related field
* Minimum of 3 years of experience with progressive responsibility in human resources or related field at a diverse, complex, multi-faceted organization.
* **Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Manager.**

  

**Additional Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated thorough knowledge of HR policies, procedures, principles, and practices. Personnel and salary administration, recruitment techniques and management.
* Solutions-oriented, demonstrating strong initiative and follow-through. A flexible and open mindset is essential.
* Ability to thrive and prioritize while working with a high volume of work, concurrent projects and critical, time sensitive deadlines with consistent accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to exercise high degree of judgment and handle confidential information with tact, discretion, and diplomacy, and to maintain strict confidentiality.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and proven organizational and interpersonal skills; ability to maintain a calm demeanor under pressure and communicate effectively at all levels within an organization.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint) and other web-based programs. Willingness and ability to learn how to use proprietary software products.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Certification as a Professional in Human Resources (PHR) or Society for Human Resources Management Certified Professional (SHRM-CP).  

  

**Working Conditions:**

* This is a hybrid position with 3-days in-office and 2-days remote.
Heavy workload and consistent, competing deadlines require that the candidate interface well with other managers, staff and faculty in a collaborative and team-oriented manner.  

  

**About the Team:**

title: HR/Payroll Specialist - School of Medicine Integrated Resources, Staff HR
description:
**Job Description**

**Please note:** **All applications must be submitted no later than 11:59pm PT on October 20, 2026.**

  

The School of Medicine Integrated Resources (SoM IR), Staff HR has an outstanding opportunity for an HR/Payroll Specialist to join their team.

  

**About this Opportunity**
==========================

Reporting to the Senior Compensation and Data Analyst, the HR/Payroll Specialist is responsible for payroll processing, reporting, compliance monitoring, and continuous process improvement in Workday. This role partners with leaders, managers, finance teams, and employees across the School of Medicine to ensure accurate and timely payroll operations while supporting an exceptional employee experience.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**HR Payroll Duties (85%)**

  

* Interpret and apply federal, state, University of Washington (UW), SoM, and SoM IR policies.
* Run and analyze standard and custom Workday reports to ensure accurate, timely payroll processing and appropriate budget allocations.
* Partner with finance contacts across SoM to process costing allocations in Workday.
* Maintain an optimal timeline for running reports, communicating them out, and applying changes or answering questions in a timely and efficient manner, according to the payroll calendar.
* Prepare and send correspondence, such as payroll reminders, to supervisors and employees.
* Support HR Business Partners and HR Operations Specialists with over/under payments submissions.
Manage and maintain HR reporting file systems. Apply appropriate file retention and naming policy to these systems to maintain organization.  

  

**Lean Process Improvement (15%)**

* Partner with Employee Workday Help (EWH) to represent SoM payroll reporting needs and contribute to Workday report improvements and new functionality.
* Identify and recommend process improvements regarding the SoM IR, Staff HR process, quality control, and SharePoint system.
* Maintain current knowledge of payroll practices, regulations, and system enhancements and share recommendations with colleagues.
Create and update team procedures, training materials, and communication templates to improve consistency and customer service.  

  

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.

==========================

* Three years of office/clerical experience.
Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.  

**Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Manager.**

* Proficient in Microsoft Suite (including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).
* Familiarity with Workday.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks on a frequent basis.

* Excellent customer service skills.
* Ability to think critically and solve problems.
* Dedication to continuous process improvement.
